Media enthusiasts who need to unify multiple sources and generate EPG guides
Families or small teams needing multi-device sharing and per-user channel sets
Developers and ops folks wanting a quick Docker-based IPTV deployment

zh.tag: 面向小学阶段的开源学习微主题知识图谱与先修依赖数据集
zh.what: 这是一个把儿童在小学阶段所学内容拆解成 1590 个细粒度「微主题」的结构化分类体系，并用 3221 条先修依赖边把它们连成有向无环图。每个主题都配有通俗描述、掌握证据、类型、学科领域和大致年龄区间，并对齐多国课程标准。
zh.content: 数据以 UTF-8 JSON 存放在 data/ 目录下，包含 topics.json（节点）、dependencies.json（先修边）、curriculum-standards.json（课程标准）、clusters.json（家长友好摘要）和 manifest.json（计数与校验和），schema/ 目录提供 JSON Schema。
zh.stack: 纯数据仓库，主体为 JSON 数据文件与 JSON Schema 校验，主语言标记为 JavaScript，可能用于可视化与校验脚本。
zh.hot: 本周新增 169 star、总计 4741 star，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 周榜第 14 名；开放且机器可读的课程知识图谱填补了教育数据空白，对 AI 教育应用和课程分析很有吸引力。
uses: 教育科技开发者，用于构建自适应学习路径与先修推荐系统
AI 教育应用团队，作为课程知识图谱与 RAG 语料
课程设计者与教研人员，用于分析学科知识结构与对齐标准
家长与教师，借助领域摘要了解孩子各年龄段应掌握的内容

en.tag: An open micro-topic learning graph with prerequisite dependencies for primary education
en.what: This is a structured taxonomy that decomposes what children learn in primary school into 1,590 fine-grained micro-topics, wired into a directed acyclic graph via 3,221 prerequisite edges. Each topic carries a plain-language description, mastery evidence, a type, subject/domain, and an approximate age range, aligned to national curriculum standards.
en.content: All data lives in data/ as UTF-8 JSON: topics.json (nodes), dependencies.json (prerequisite edges), curriculum-standards.json (source standards), clusters.json (parent-friendly summaries), and manifest.json (counts and checksums), with JSON Schemas under schema/.
en.stack: A pure data repository built around JSON files and JSON Schemas, with JavaScript as the primary language, likely for visualization and validation scripts.
en.hot: With 4,741 stars and 169 added this week, it ranks 14th on the GitHub Trending weekly JavaScript chart; an open, machine-readable curriculum knowledge graph fills an education-data gap and appeals to AI-edtech and curriculum-analysis use cases.
uses: Edtech developers building adaptive learning paths and prerequisite recommendation systems
AI education teams using it as a curriculum knowledge graph and RAG corpus
Curriculum designers and researchers analyzing subject knowledge structure and standard alignment
Parents and teachers exploring domain summaries of what children should learn at each age

zh.tag: 跑在单个 Cloudflare Worker 上的抗审查代理面板，自带多用户管理与订阅分发

zh.content: 仓库包含 Worker 端核心代码（JavaScript）、双语（英/波斯语，另有俄语）管理面板前端、订阅生成与路由规则模块，以及 Telegram 机器人、Backend 模式和多平台客户端配置模板。
zh.stack: 主语言 JavaScript，运行于 Cloudflare Workers 免费套餐，兼容 Amnezia、WireGuard、Sing-box、Clash/Mihomo、Xray 等内核，依赖 Cloudflare 边缘网络与 WARP。
zh.hot: 凭借 3345 颗星、本周新增 49 星登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 JavaScript 第 13 名，主打零成本、单 Worker 部署与抗审查能力，切中伊朗等高压网络环境用户的刚需。
uses: 需要自建抗审查代理的伊朗及其他高审查地区用户
想零成本在 Cloudflare 免费套餐上搭建多用户代理服务的个人或小团队
需要给他人分发订阅链接并管理配额、到期时间的运营者
希望用 Telegram 机器人远程管理代理节点的技术用户

en.tag: A censorship-resistant proxy panel with full admin UI running on a single Cloudflare Worker
en.what: Nova-Proxy is a proxy control panel that runs entirely on Cloudflare Workers, bundling VLESS, Trojan, Shadowsocks, gRPC and XHTTP over WebSocket+TLS with a full admin dashboard. Deployed to your own free Cloudflare account, it lets you create multi-user accounts, hand out private subscription links, and fight censorship with WARP, proxy chaining, clean-IP optimization and advanced routing.
en.content: The repo contains the Worker-side core in JavaScript, a bilingual (English/Persian, plus Russian) admin panel frontend, subscription-generation and routing-rule modules, plus a Telegram bot, Backend mode and client config templates for all platforms.
en.stack: JavaScript running on Cloudflare Workers' free tier, compatible with Amnezia, WireGuard, Sing-box, Clash/Mihomo and Xray cores, relying on Cloudflare's edge network and WARP.
en.hot: With 3,345 stars and 49 added this week, it ranks 13th on GitHub's weekly JavaScript trending list, driven by zero-cost single-Worker deployment and strong censorship resistance for users in heavily filtered networks like Iran.
uses: Users in Iran and other heavily censored regions who need a self-hosted anti-censorship proxy
Individuals or small teams wanting a zero-cost multi-user proxy on Cloudflare's free plan
Operators who need to distribute subscription links and manage quotas and expiry dates
Technical users who want to manage proxy nodes remotely via a Telegram bot

en.stack: Written primarily in Rust, it relies on dynarmic for CPU emulation and reimplements iOS system frameworks itself; officially supported on x64 Windows, x64 macOS and AArch64 Android.

uses: 开发者和性能工程师 —— 用于比较不同命令行工具或程序的执行效率。
CI/CD 流程 —— 集成到自动化测试中，监控性能回归。
学术研究 —— 进行可重复的命令行基准测试实验。
日常脚本优化 —— 快速测试不同命令或参数的耗时。

en.tag: A command-line benchmarking tool with statistical analysis, warmup, and parameter scans
en.what: hyperfine is a command-line benchmarking tool for accurately measuring and comparing the execution time of arbitrary shell commands or programs. It automatically performs multiple runs, statistical analysis, and supports advanced features like warmup, cache clearing, and parameterized scans.
en.content: The repository contains the complete Rust source code, test suite, documentation, and examples, with the core being a command-line binary installable via cargo or pre-built binaries.
en.stack: Written in Rust, with dependencies including clap for argument parsing, statistical for analysis, serde for serialization, and cross-platform support for Linux, macOS, and Windows.
en.hot: hyperfine is widely popular for its simplicity and powerful features, with 29,038 stars and 106 new stars this week, ranking 10th on GitHub Trending weekly for Rust.
uses: Developers and performance engineers — compare the efficiency of different CLI tools or programs.
CI/CD pipelines — integrate into automated testing to monitor performance regressions.
Academic research — conduct reproducible command-line benchmarking experiments.
Everyday script optimization — quickly test the time consumption of different commands or parameters.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 出品的自主 AI 代理安全私有运行时
zh.what: OpenShell 为自主 AI 代理提供隔离沙箱运行时，让代理能读文件、装包、调 API、用凭证，但不会获得对数据、密钥和网络的无限访问权。用户通过策略声明每个代理能触碰什么，OpenShell 在内核层强制执行。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 实现的 CLI 与本地 gateway、内核级沙箱与 supervisor 组件、策略定义与形式化验证模块，以及文档、品牌资源和安装脚本。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供 PyPI 包 openshell，依赖 Docker、Podman 或主机虚拟化，支持 Linux、Apple Silicon macOS 和 WSL 2。
zh.hot: 凭借 NVIDIA 品牌背书和「代理安全」这一 2025 年最热议题，项目单日新增 990 star、总数达 10622，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2。
uses: 需要让 AI 代理安全访问文件、API 和凭证的企业开发团队
构建多代理系统、关注沙箱隔离与权限治理的平台工程师
研究代理安全、策略形式化验证的安全与合规人员

en.tag: NVIDIA's safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents
en.what: OpenShell is a runtime that sandboxes autonomous AI agents so they can read files, install packages, call APIs and use credentials without gaining unrestricted access to your data, secrets or network. You declare what each agent may touch in a policy, and OpenShell enforces it.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based CLI and local gateway, kernel-level sandbox and supervisor components, policy definitions with formal verification, plus docs, brand assets and an install script.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, distributed as the openshell PyPI package, and relies on Docker, Podman or host virtualization across Linux, Apple Silicon macOS and WSL 2.
en.hot: Backed by NVIDIA and riding the hottest 2025 topic of agent safety, it gained 990 stars in a single day to reach 10,622 and hit #2 on GitHub Trending daily.
uses: Enterprise teams that need AI agents to safely access files, APIs and credentials
Platform engineers building multi-agent systems with sandboxing and permission governance
Security and compliance staff researching agent safety and formal policy verification

zh.tag: 25MB 轻量级跨平台数据库客户端，支持 100+ 数据库并内置 AI 与 MCP。
zh.what: DBX 是一款仅 25 MB 的轻量级跨平台数据库管理工具，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQLite、Redis、MongoDB、DuckDB、SQL Server、达梦等 100+ 数据库。它提供桌面端、Docker、CLI 三种形态，并内置 AI 助手和 MCP Server，方便开发者统一管理多种数据库。
zh.content: 仓库包含桌面应用、Docker 镜像、CLI 工具以及内置 AI 助手和 MCP Server 的完整实现，主语言为 Rust。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 构建，依赖跨平台 GUI 框架和数据库驱动，支持多种数据库协议，并集成 AI 与 MCP 服务。
zh.hot: 凭借 25 MB 超小体积、100+ 数据库支持和内置 AI/MCP 等亮点，项目已获得 22026 颗星，今日新增 232 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5 名。
uses: 需要同时管理多种数据库的开发者与 DBA，可在一个工具中完成跨库操作。
追求轻量、快速启动的数据库客户端用户，替代笨重的传统 GUI 工具。
希望利用 AI 助手和 MCP 提升数据库查询与管理效率的团队。
需要在 Docker 或 CLI 环境中进行数据库操作的 DevOps 与自动化场景。

en.tag: 25 MB lightweight cross-platform database client for 100+ databases with built-in AI and MCP.
en.what: DBX is a 25 MB lightweight cross-platform database management tool that supports 100+ databases including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQLite, Redis, MongoDB, DuckDB, SQL Server, and Dameng. It offers desktop, Docker, and CLI forms, with a built-in AI assistant and MCP Server for unified database management.
en.content: The repository contains the full implementation of the desktop app, Docker image, CLI tool, built-in AI assistant, and MCP Server, primarily written in Rust.
en.stack: Built with Rust, leveraging cross-platform GUI frameworks and database drivers, supporting multiple database protocols with integrated AI and MCP services.
en.hot: With its ultra-small 25 MB size, support for 100+ databases, and built-in AI/MCP features, the project has earned 22,026 stars, with 232 added today, ranking 5th on GitHub Trending daily.

Users seeking a lightweight, fast-starting database client to replace bulky traditional GUI tools.
Teams wanting to leverage AI assistant and MCP to improve database query and management efficiency.
DevOps and automation scenarios requiring database operations in Docker or CLI environments.

zh.tag: 用 Rust 重写的经典 Photoshop 风格桌面图像编辑器，原生支持 PSD/PSB
zh.what: PhotoSuite 是一款原生桌面图像编辑器，界面与操作逻辑致敬经典 Adobe Photoshop，并原生读写 PSD/PSB 文件。目标是实现与 Photoshop 之间完整的 PSD 往返编辑，包括图层效果与智能对象/滤镜，目前仍在开发中。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整应用源码：基于 PhotoCraft 引擎的文档模型、PSD 读写器、合成器与命令系统，外加 PhotoSuite 自己的界面与工具层，并提供 macOS/Windows/Linux 各平台安装包与构建脚本。
zh.stack: 100% Rust 编写，构建在开源 Rust 图像引擎 PhotoCraft 之上，采用 MIT OR Apache-2.0 双许可；早期版本曾用 JS + Tauri，现已转向更现代、更高性能的原生方案。
zh.hot: 915 颗星、今日新增 77，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜 Rust 第 4 名；用 Rust 复刻 Photoshop 并原生兼容 PSD 的定位切中痛点，加上跨平台安装包齐全，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 想摆脱 Adobe 订阅、寻找开源 Photoshop 替代品的图像编辑用户
需要在程序中读写 PSD/PSB 的开发者，可参考其 PSD 解析与合成实现
对 Rust 桌面 GUI、图像处理引擎与跨平台打包感兴趣的工程师
希望参与开源图像编辑器、贡献工具与滤镜功能的贡献者

en.tag: A Rust-written desktop image editor faithful to classic Photoshop, with native PSD/PSB support
en.what: PhotoSuite is a native desktop image editor that mirrors classic Adobe Photoshop's workflow and natively reads and writes PSD/PSB files. It aims for full Photoshop-to-PhotoSuite PSD round trips, including layer effects and smart objects/filters, and is still a work in progress.
en.content: The repo holds the full application source: PhotoCraft's document model, PSD reader/writer, compositor and command system, plus PhotoSuite's own UI and tools, along with installers and build scripts for macOS, Windows and Linux.
en.stack: Written 100% in Rust on top of the open-source PhotoCraft image engine, dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0; an earlier JS + Tauri version has been replaced by a more modern, performant native approach.
en.hot: With 915 stars and 77 added today, it hit #4 on GitHub Trending (Rust daily); the pitch of a Rust Photoshop clone with native PSD compatibility plus ready-made cross-platform installers is drawing heavy attention.
uses: Image editors seeking an open-source Photoshop alternative without Adobe subscriptions
Developers needing to read/write PSD/PSB, who can study its PSD parsing and compositing code
Engineers curious about Rust desktop GUI, image-processing engines and cross-platform packaging
Contributors wanting to help build tools and filters for an open-source image editor

zh.tag: 本地优先的多设备编码代理控制平面
zh.what: Zeron 是一个面向 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Devin 等编码代理的原生控制平面。它默认在本地运行，每台设备上的小型引擎把会话存在本机，无需账号或联网即可使用，并可选开启多设备同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的引擎与守护进程、桌面侧边栏应用、落地页资源（apps/landing）、安装脚本以及架构与 Linux/Windows 参考文档。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，提供 CLI（zeron status/update/daemon）、安装脚本与桌面应用；依赖本地守护进程与可选的同步账户体系。
zh.hot: 本周新增 394 星、总计 1823 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 周榜第 14 名；本地优先、多代理统一管控的定位正好切中编码代理爆发的痛点。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、希望统一管理会话的开发者
注重隐私、要求会话数据默认留在本地的团队
需要在一台常开机器上远程驱动其他设备代理的用户
想研究编码代理控制平面架构的 Rust 开发者

en.tag: A local-first control plane for coding agents across devices
en.what: Zeron is a native control plane for coding agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Devin. It runs locally by default, with each device storing sessions on-device and no account or network required, plus optional multi-device sync.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust engine and daemon, a desktop sidebar app, landing page assets under apps/landing, an install script, and architecture plus Linux/Windows reference docs.
en.stack: Primarily Rust, offering a CLI (zeron status/update/daemon), an install script, and a desktop app; it relies on a local daemon and an optional synced account system.
en.hot: It gained 394 stars this week for 1,823 total, ranking 14th on GitHub Trending's weekly Rust list; its local-first, multi-agent control positioning hits a real pain point as coding agents proliferate.
uses: Developers juggling multiple coding agents who want unified session management
Teams that prioritize privacy and want sessions to stay local by default
Users who need an always-on machine to drive agents on other devices remotely
Rust developers curious about coding-agent control plane architecture

zh.tag: 默认开启 HTTPS 的快速可扩展多平台 Web 服务器
zh.what: Caddy 是一个用 Go 编写的开源 Web 服务器与服务器平台，支持 HTTP/1、HTTP/2 和 HTTP/3。它最大的特点是默认自动为站点申请并续期 TLS 证书，让「每个站点都上 HTTPS」变得开箱即用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Caddy 核心服务器代码、模块化插件体系、命令行工具，以及大量文档与示例配置；采用 Apache-2.0 许可，由 CertMagic 提供证书自动化能力。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，核心依赖包括 CertMagic（自动 HTTPS）、quic-go（HTTP/3）等；以单一静态二进制分发，跨平台运行，配置可用 Caddyfile 或原生 JSON。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub 上最受欢迎的 Go Web 服务器之一，Caddy 已积累 77,499 颗星，今日再增 93 星并登上 Go 日榜第一，说明「自动 HTTPS + 简洁配置」的刚需持续吸引开发者。
uses: 运维与后端开发者：快速部署带 HTTPS 的网站或 API 服务
个人开发者与自托管爱好者：用极简配置托管个人站点和反代
需要 HTTP/3 或自动证书管理的团队：替代 Nginx/Apache 的现代方案
学习 Go 与网络服务器架构的工程师：阅读模块化服务器实现

en.tag: Fast, extensible multi-platform web server with automatic HTTPS by default
en.what: Caddy is an open-source web server and server platform written in Go, supporting HTTP/1, HTTP/2, and HTTP/3. Its standout feature is automatic TLS certificate issuance and renewal by default, making HTTPS the zero-config norm for every site.
en.content: The repo contains the core Caddy server, its modular plugin system, the CLI tool, plus extensive docs and example configs; it is Apache-2.0 licensed and relies on CertMagic for certificate automation.
en.stack: Written in Go, with key dependencies like CertMagic (automatic HTTPS) and quic-go (HTTP/3); it ships as a single static binary, runs cross-platform, and is configured via Caddyfile or native JSON.
en.hot: As one of the most popular Go web servers on GitHub, Caddy has reached 77,499 stars, gaining 93 more today and topping the Go daily trending list — proof that 'automatic HTTPS plus simple config' remains a strong draw.
uses: DevOps and backend developers: quickly deploy HTTPS-enabled sites or APIs
Indie developers and self-hosters: host personal sites and reverse proxies with minimal config
Teams needing HTTP/3 or automatic cert management: a modern Nginx/Apache alternative
Engineers studying Go and server architecture: read a modular server implementation

zh.tag: 懂你 AI 代理在干什么的终端窗口管理器
zh.what: TUIOS 是一个用 Go 编写的现代终端复用器与窗口管理器，在现有终端内提供 vim 风格模态操作、多窗格、工作区与 BSP 平铺布局。它通过守护进程让会话跨重启存活、可跨机器连接，并让窗格里的编码代理上报状态、互相通信，统一收进一个 Inbox。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 源码、docs/ 文档目录（入门、快捷键、BSP 平铺、布局模式、配置、Hooks、主题等）、品牌与演示素材，以及 tuios.dev 上的完整文档和 WebAssembly 在线体验版。
zh.stack: 基于 Charm 技术栈（Bubble Tea v2、Lipgloss v2），采用事件驱动渲染实现近乎零空闲 CPU 占用，支持 kitty 图形协议与无闪烁图片透传，依赖 Go 工具链。
zh.hot: 上线即获 4317 颗星、今日新增 147，位列 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 2，还被评为 Terminal Trove 周度工具；它切中了多代理编码时代对终端会话管理与代理状态可视化的真实需求。
uses: 同时运行多个编码代理、需要统一查看其状态的开发者
习惯 tmux/vim 模态操作、想要更现代终端复用体验的用户
需要跨机器保持长会话、断线重连的远程开发者
希望用 Hooks 和主题深度定制终端工作流的进阶用户

en.tag: A terminal window manager that knows what your coding agents are doing
en.what: TUIOS is a modern terminal multiplexer and window manager written in Go, offering a vim-like modal interface with multiple panes, workspaces and BSP tiling inside your existing terminal. A daemon keeps sessions alive across restarts, reaches sessions on other machines, and lets coding agents in panes report state and message each other through one Inbox.
en.content: The repo ships Go source, a docs/ folder (getting started, keybindings, BSP tiling, layout modes, configuration, hooks, themes), brand and demo assets, plus full documentation and a WebAssembly guided tour at tuios.dev.
en.stack: Built on the Charm stack (Bubble Tea v2, Lipgloss v2) with event-driven rendering for near-zero idle CPU, kitty graphics protocol and flicker-free image passthrough, all on the Go toolchain.
en.hot: It has quickly reached 4,317 stars with 147 added today, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending (Go) and earning Terminal Trove's Tool of the Week; it hits a real need for session management and agent-state visibility in the multi-agent coding era.
uses: Developers running multiple coding agents who need a unified view of their state
Users who like tmux/vim modal workflows but want a more modern multiplexer
Remote developers needing long-lived sessions that survive restarts and span machines
Power users who want to customize workflows deeply with hooks and themes

zh.tag: 覆盖30+协议并内置自主AI Agent的一体化终端
zh.what: uniTerm 是一款跨平台一体化终端工具，把 SSH、RDP、SFTP、数据库、Kubernetes 等 30 多种远程访问协议整合到一个应用里。它还内置 AI Agent，可以自主执行多轮 shell 命令，帮助用户完成运维和排障任务。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的桌面应用源码、构建脚本与资源文件，按功能划分为终端、文件传输、远程桌面、数据库、容器等模块，并提供多语言 README 与用户指南。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，采用 Wails 等桌面框架构建跨平台 GUI，支持 Windows、macOS、Linux 和 Android；依赖涵盖 SSH、RDP、VNC、数据库驱动及 Kubernetes 客户端库。
zh.hot: 项目已获 774 颗星，今日新增 20 星并登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 5 名，说明“终端 + AI Agent”这一组合正切中运维自动化的需求。
uses: 运维工程师：用统一终端管理服务器、数据库与 Kubernetes 集群
开发者：在本地与远程环境间切换，并用 AI Agent 自动执行命令
网络与系统管理员：通过 RDP/VNC/串口等协议维护异构设备
喜欢尝鲜的终端用户：想体验 AI 驱动的自动化 shell 工作流

en.tag: All-in-one terminal with 30+ protocols and a built-in autonomous AI agent
en.what: uniTerm is a cross-platform all-in-one terminal that unifies 30+ remote-access protocols such as SSH, RDP, SFTP, databases and Kubernetes in a single app. It also ships a built-in AI agent that autonomously runs multi-turn shell commands for ops and troubleshooting.
en.content: The repo contains the Go desktop app source, build scripts and assets, organized into modules for terminal, file transfer, remote desktop, database and containers, plus multilingual READMEs and a user guide.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go and built with a desktop framework such as Wails for cross-platform GUI on Windows, macOS, Linux and Android; dependencies span SSH, RDP, VNC, database drivers and Kubernetes client libraries.
en.hot: With 774 stars and 20 added today, it ranks 5th on GitHub Trending's daily Go list, showing that the 'terminal + AI agent' combo hits a real ops-automation need.
uses: DevOps engineers managing servers, databases and Kubernetes clusters from one terminal
Developers switching between local and remote environments while letting the AI agent run commands
Network and sysadmins maintaining heterogeneous devices via RDP, VNC or serial
Early adopters curious about AI-driven automated shell workflows

zh.tag: 全能安全扫描器：容器、K8s、代码、云一网打尽
zh.what: Trivy 是一款综合性的安全扫描工具，能够检测容器镜像、文件系统、Git 仓库、虚拟机镜像和 Kubernetes 中的漏洞、配置错误、敏感信息与许可证问题。它通过多种扫描器（scanner）针对不同目标（target）发现安全问题，并生成 SBOM。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 语言编写的核心扫描引擎、丰富的文档（docs 目录）、安装脚本、集成示例（如 GitHub Actions、K8s operator、VS Code 插件）以及测试代码。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖多个开源库进行漏洞数据库查询、文件系统解析和镜像层分析，支持跨平台运行。
zh.hot: 作为云原生安全领域的标杆工具，Trivy 拥有超过 38k stars，今日新增 19 星并登上 Go 日榜第一，反映出社区对 DevSecOps 和供应链安全的高度关注。
uses: DevSecOps 工程师：在 CI/CD 流水线中集成 Trivy 进行自动化安全扫描
云原生开发者：扫描容器镜像和 Kubernetes 集群，确保部署安全
安全分析师：快速检测代码仓库中的漏洞、密钥和错误配置
开源维护者：生成 SBOM 并检查依赖项许可证合规性

en.tag: All-in-one security scanner for containers, K8s, code, and clouds
en.what: Trivy is a comprehensive security scanner that detects vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, secrets, and licenses in container images, filesystems, Git repositories, VM images, and Kubernetes. It uses multiple scanners against various targets and can generate SBOMs.
en.content: The repository contains the Go-based core scanning engine, extensive documentation (docs directory), installation scripts, integration examples (GitHub Actions, K8s operator, VS Code plugin), and test code.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, it relies on various open-source libraries for vulnerability database queries, filesystem parsing, and image layer analysis, and runs cross-platform.
en.hot: As a benchmark tool in cloud-native security, Trivy has over 38k stars, gained 19 today, and topped the Go daily trending list, reflecting strong community focus on DevSecOps and supply chain security.
uses: DevSecOps engineers: integrate Trivy into CI/CD pipelines for automated security scanning
Cloud-native developers: scan container images and Kubernetes clusters to ensure deployment security
Security analysts: quickly detect vulnerabilities, secrets, and misconfigurations in code repositories
Open-source maintainers: generate SBOMs and check dependency license compliance

zh.tag: 为 Web 应用提供 OAuth2/OIDC 认证的反向代理
zh.what: OAuth2 Proxy 是一个开源的反向代理，可为 Web 应用加上 OAuth2 / OIDC 登录认证。它既能独立部署，也能作为中间件嵌入已有的反向代理或负载均衡架构中，拦截请求并把未登录用户重定向到身份提供商。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的代理核心、各身份提供商（Google、Microsoft Entra ID、GitHub、login.gov 及通用 OIDC）的实现、文档站点与本地环境示例配置。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，依赖标准 OAuth2/OIDC 协议库，提供多架构预编译二进制，可容器化部署。
zh.hot: 作为自托管应用统一登录的成熟方案，它已积累约 1.5 万 star，本周仍新增 28 star 并进入 Go 周榜第 16 名，说明企业内网与自建服务的认证需求持续旺盛。
uses: 运维/平台工程师为内网自建服务统一接入企业 SSO
开发者想给没有内置登录的 Web 应用快速加上 OAuth2/OIDC 认证
需要在 Kubernetes Ingress 或 Nginx 前做统一身份校验的团队

en.tag: A reverse proxy that adds OAuth2/OIDC authentication to your web apps
en.what: OAuth2 Proxy is an open-source reverse proxy that adds OAuth2/OIDC authentication to web applications. It can run standalone or as middleware inside existing reverse proxies and load balancers, intercepting requests and redirecting unauthenticated users to an identity provider.
en.content: The repo contains the Go proxy core, provider implementations (Google, Microsoft Entra ID, GitHub, login.gov and generic OIDC), a docs site, and example local-environment configs.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go, relying on standard OAuth2/OIDC libraries, shipping prebuilt binaries for many architectures and deployable as a container.
en.hot: As a mature way to add single sign-on to self-hosted apps, it has around 15k stars and still gained 28 this week, ranking 16th on the Go weekly trending list, showing steady demand for auth in internal and self-hosted services.
uses: Ops/platform engineers adding corporate SSO to internal self-hosted services
Developers wanting to quickly add OAuth2/OIDC login to apps lacking built-in auth
Teams needing centralized identity checks in front of Kubernetes Ingress or Nginx

zh.tag: 用 Go 写的轻量级自托管一体化 DevOps 平台
zh.what: Gitea 是一个用 Go 编写的自托管软件开发服务，把 Git 托管、代码评审、Issue 跟踪、项目看板、Wiki、团队协作、包注册表和 CI/CD 集成在一个二进制里。目标是让搭建自托管开发平台变得最简单、最快、最省心。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 服务端源码、前端资源、数据库迁移脚本、Docker 与 Helm 部署配置、多语言翻译文件以及详细的安装、管理与开发文档。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Go，前端使用 TypeScript/Vue，支持 SQLite、MySQL、PostgreSQL 等数据库，可编译为单一二进制并跨 Linux、macOS、Windows、ARM、RISC-V 等平台运行。
zh.hot: 作为 GitHub/GitLab 的轻量自托管替代品，Gitea 已积累 58,355 颗星，本周再增 128 星并登上 Go 周榜第 5，社区对数据自主与低资源部署的需求持续推动其热度。
uses: 希望自托管代码仓库、保护数据主权的个人开发者与小团队
需要内网部署 Git 服务与 CI/CD 的企业或组织
在 ARM、RISC-V 等边缘设备上搭建轻量开发平台的用户
想用单一二进制快速替代 GitHub/GitLab 的运维人员

en.tag: A painless self-hosted all-in-one DevOps platform written in Go
en.what: Gitea is a self-hosted software development service written in Go that bundles Git hosting, code review, issue tracking, project kanban, wiki, team collaboration, package registry and CI/CD into one binary. Its goal is to make setting up a self-hosted all-in-one development platform as easy, fast and painless as possible.
en.content: The repo contains the full Go server source, frontend assets, database migration scripts, Docker and Helm deployment configs, multilingual translation files, and detailed installation, admin and development docs.
en.stack: Written mainly in Go with a TypeScript/Vue frontend, it supports SQLite, MySQL and PostgreSQL, compiles to a single binary, and runs across Linux, macOS, Windows, ARM, RISC-V and more.
en.hot: As a lightweight self-hosted alternative to GitHub/GitLab, Gitea has reached 58,355 stars, adding 128 this week and ranking 5th on the Go weekly trending list, driven by demand for data ownership and low-resource deployment.
uses: Individual developers and small teams wanting self-hosted repos and data sovereignty
Enterprises or organizations needing on-premise Git hosting and CI/CD
Users deploying lightweight dev platforms on ARM, RISC-V or edge devices
Ops engineers seeking a single-binary replacement for GitHub/GitLab

zh.tag: 用原始人语体为编码代理节省65% token的爆红技能与代理
zh.what: Caveman 是一个让 AI 编码代理用极简“原始人语”交流的技能与代理，通过减少输入和输出 token 来降低使用成本，同时保持代码精确和答案正确。它支持 30 多种代理，并已通过 Adobe Research、JetBrains 等机构的测试验证。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个可安装的 CLI 工具（npm 包 @caveman-ai/cli）、一个代理技能（/caveman）、以及代理模式，还有基准测试文档和演示资源。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，提供 npm 包，依赖代理框架和 API，支持与多种编码代理集成。
zh.hot: 凭借 65% 的 token 节省效果和幽默的“原始人”概念，该项目在 Hacker News 和 GitHub Trending 上排名第一，已获得超过 11 万星标，本周新增 2026 星。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理的开发者，希望降低 API 成本 —— 通过 caveman 技能或代理减少 token 消耗。
团队协作场景，需要控制代理输出长度并保持代码准确性 —— 适合集成到现有工作流。
对 token 优化感兴趣的研究人员或爱好者 —— 可参考基准测试和第三方验证。

en.tag: Viral skill + proxy for coding agents that cuts 65% of tokens by talking like a caveman.
en.what: Caveman is a skill and proxy that makes AI coding agents talk in a minimal 'caveman' style to cut token usage while keeping code exact and answers correct. It works with 30+ agents and has been tested by Adobe Research, JetBrains, and others.
en.content: The repo includes an installable CLI (npm package @caveman-ai/cli), an agent skill (/caveman), a proxy mode, plus benchmark docs and demo assets.
en.stack: Primarily built in Go, distributed as an npm package, and integrates with various coding agents via proxy or skill.
en.hot: With 65% token savings and a humorous caveman concept, it hit #1 on Hacker News and GitHub Trending, gaining over 110k stars, including 2,026 this week.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents who want to reduce API costs — use the caveman skill or proxy to cut token usage.
Teams needing to control agent output length while keeping code accurate — easy to integrate into existing workflows.
Researchers or enthusiasts interested in token optimization — benchmark tests and third-party validations are available.

zh.tag: 为容器提供用户态应用内核的强隔离沙箱运行时
zh.what: gVisor 是 Google 开源的容器应用内核，在应用与宿主操作系统之间提供强隔离层。它用内存安全的 Go 语言在用户态实现类 Linux 接口，并附带 OCI 运行时 runsc，可无缝对接 Docker 与 Kubernetes。
zh.content: 仓库包含用户态内核源码（如 pkg/sentry 系统调用实现）、OCI 运行时 runsc、平台抽象层以及 Bazel 构建配置和 gvisor.dev 文档。
zh.stack: 主要用 Go 编写，使用 Bazel 构建，支持 x86_64 与 ARM64，依赖 Linux 宿主内核能力并集成 Docker/Kubernetes 生态。
zh.hot: 作为容器安全隔离的标杆方案，gVisor 已积累近 2 万 star，本周新增 127 星并登上 Go 周榜第 8，反映多租户与不可信负载场景下对强沙箱的持续需求。
uses: 云平台与多租户环境，需要安全运行不可信容器负载的工程师
在 Kubernetes 上部署沙箱化容器的平台与安全团队
研究容器隔离、系统调用拦截与用户态内核的技术人员
希望在不牺牲启动速度的前提下获得类 VM 隔离的开发者

en.tag: A userspace application kernel delivering strong sandbox isolation for containers
en.what: gVisor is Google's open-source application kernel that adds a strong isolation layer between applications and the host OS. Written in memory-safe Go and running in userspace, it implements a Linux-like interface and ships an OCI runtime called runsc that plugs into Docker and Kubernetes.
en.content: The repo contains the userspace kernel source (e.g. pkg/sentry syscall implementations), the runsc OCI runtime, platform abstraction layers, plus Bazel build configs and gvisor.dev docs.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go and built with Bazel, supporting x86_64 and ARM64; it leverages host Linux kernel features and integrates with the Docker/Kubernetes ecosystem.
en.hot: As a flagship container isolation approach, gVisor has nearly 20k stars, adding 127 this week to rank 8th on the Go trending list, reflecting steady demand for strong sandboxes in multi-tenant and untrusted-workload scenarios.
uses: Cloud and multi-tenant engineers who must run untrusted container workloads safely
Platform and security teams deploying sandboxed containers on Kubernetes
Researchers studying container isolation, syscall interception, and userspace kernels
Developers wanting VM-like isolation without sacrificing fast startup

zh.tag: 给 JavaScript 加上类型系统的编译器与语言工具链
zh.what: TypeScript 是 JavaScript 的超集，为其添加可选静态类型，让大型应用在任意浏览器、宿主和操作系统上都能获得更好的工具支持。它最终编译输出可读、符合标准的 JavaScript 代码。
zh.content: 仓库包含编译器源码（现以 Go 重写实现）、语言服务、类型检查器、测试套件与文档，并配套 npm 包 typescript 及 nightly 版本。
zh.stack: 核心编译器已用 Go 重写以提升性能，对外以 npm 包发布，依赖 Node.js 生态与 GitHub Actions CI。
zh.hot: 作为前端与 Node 生态的基石项目，它已累积 111,394 颗星，今日新增 19 星并登上 Go 日榜第 18 名，Go 重写带来的性能话题持续引发关注。
uses: 前端与 Node.js 开发者，用类型系统提升大型项目的可维护性
库与框架作者，需要发布带类型声明的 npm 包
团队希望在不放弃 JavaScript 生态的前提下引入静态检查

en.tag: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to clean JavaScript
en.what: TypeScript is a superset of JavaScript that adds optional static types, enabling tooling for application-scale JavaScript across any browser, host, or OS. It compiles down to readable, standards-based JavaScript output.
en.content: The repo holds the compiler source (now rewritten in Go), the language service, type checker, test suites, and docs, shipping as the npm package typescript plus nightly builds.
en.stack: The core compiler has been rewritten in Go for performance, distributed via npm, and relies on the Node.js ecosystem with GitHub Actions CI.
en.hot: As a cornerstone of the frontend and Node ecosystem, it has amassed 111,394 stars, adding 19 today and ranking 18th on the Go daily trending list, fueled by interest in the Go rewrite's performance gains.
uses: Frontend and Node.js developers improving maintainability of large projects with types
Library and framework authors shipping npm packages with type declarations
Teams wanting static checking without leaving the JavaScript ecosystem

zh.tag: 收录300+个智能体AI资源的精选清单
zh.what: 这是一个由Slava Kurilyak维护的Awesome清单，系统整理了300多个智能体AI（agentic AI）相关项目与资源。每个条目都标注了原始提交者和当前维护者，并要求项目必须有公开的GitHub、GitLab或Codeberg仓库。
zh.content: 仓库以分类目录形式组织，包含AI Agents（103个）、AI Agent Frameworks、AI Agent Tools等多个类别，每个项目附有链接和简要说明。
zh.stack: 仓库本身以Go语言标记为主，但内容主要是Markdown文档和链接列表，不依赖特定运行时。
zh.hot: 本周新增129颗星，总星数达2416，登上GitHub Trending周榜（Go）第14名，反映出智能体AI领域的持续高热度和开发者对资源聚合的强烈需求。
uses: AI开发者与研究者，快速查找智能体相关项目与工具
产品经理与创业者，调研智能体AI生态与竞品
技术爱好者，跟进智能体领域最新开源动态

en.tag: Curated awesome list of 300+ agentic AI resources
en.what: This is an Awesome list maintained by Slava Kurilyak that curates 300+ agentic AI projects and resources. Each listing credits the original submitter and current maintainers, and requires a public repository on GitHub, GitLab.com, or Codeberg.
en.content: The repo is organized as categorized directories, including AI Agents (103), AI Agent Frameworks, AI Agent Tools, and more, with each project linked and briefly described.
en.stack: The repo is primarily marked as Go, but its content is mainly Markdown docs and link lists, with no specific runtime dependency.
en.hot: It gained 129 stars this week, reaching 2,416 total, and ranked 14th on GitHub Trending (Go) weekly, reflecting the ongoing hype around agentic AI and strong demand for resource aggregation.
uses: AI developers and researchers looking for agent-related projects and tools
Product managers and founders researching the agentic AI ecosystem and competitors
Tech enthusiasts following the latest open-source trends in agentic AI

zh.tag: 无密码的轻量级 OIDC/OAuth 2.0 身份认证服务
zh.what: Pocket ID 是一个自托管的 OpenID Connect 认证和 OAuth 2.0 提供程序，允许用户使用 Passkey（如指纹、面部识别或 YubiKey）登录你的应用。它专注于简单易用，仅支持无密码认证，适合不想部署复杂身份系统的场景。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的后端服务、前端界面、Docker 部署配置、文档以及贡献指南。核心是一个可独立运行的认证服务器，提供管理界面和 OIDC 标准端点。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，依赖 OIDC/OAuth 2.0 协议库和 WebAuthn 实现 Passkey 认证。推荐通过 Docker 部署，也支持其他方式。
zh.hot: 凭借无密码、易部署的特点，Pocket ID 在自托管社区迅速流行，已获得 9467 颗星，本周新增 132 星，位列 GitHub Go 趋势榜第 11 名。
uses: 自托管爱好者：希望为家庭实验室或小型服务添加安全的单点登录，又不想维护 Keycloak 等复杂系统。
注重安全的团队：想通过 Passkey 和硬件密钥（如 YubiKey）实现无密码登录，提升账户安全性。
开发者：需要快速集成 OIDC/OAuth 2.0 认证到自己的应用中，且偏好轻量级方案。
中小企业：寻求低成本、易管理的身份认证解决方案，避免云服务锁定。

en.tag: A lightweight, passkey-only OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 provider
en.what: Pocket ID is a self-hosted OpenID Connect Certified™ and OAuth 2.0 provider that lets users sign in to your applications using passkeys (e.g., biometrics or YubiKey). It focuses on simplicity and is passwordless-only, ideal for those who don't need complex identity systems.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based backend, a frontend UI, Docker deployment configurations, documentation, and contribution guidelines. At its core is a standalone authentication server with an admin interface and standard OIDC endpoints.
en.stack: Primarily built with Go, leveraging OIDC/OAuth 2.0 protocol libraries and WebAuthn for passkey authentication. Docker is the recommended deployment method, though other options are supported.
en.hot: With its passwordless, easy-to-deploy approach, Pocket ID has gained rapid popularity in the self-hosting community, earning 9,467 stars with 132 added this week, ranking 11th on GitHub's Go trending list.
uses: Self-hosting enthusiasts: want to add secure single sign-on to home labs or small services without maintaining complex systems like Keycloak.
Security-focused teams: aim to enable passwordless login via passkeys and hardware keys (e.g., YubiKey) to enhance account security.
Developers: need to quickly integrate OIDC/OAuth 2.0 authentication into their apps and prefer a lightweight solution.
Small to medium businesses: seek a low-cost, easy-to-manage identity solution without cloud vendor lock-in.

zh.tag: 通过 MCP 协议让 AI 助手安全访问你的个人 WhatsApp 消息
zh.what: 这是一个基于 Model Context Protocol (MCP) 的服务器，允许 AI 助手（如 Claude）搜索和读取你的个人 WhatsApp 消息（包括图片、视频、文档和音频），搜索联系人，并向个人或群组发送消息和媒体文件。它通过 WhatsApp Web 多设备 API 直接连接你的个人账户，所有消息本地存储在 SQLite 数据库中，仅在 AI 通过工具访问时才会发送给 LLM。
zh.content: 仓库包含一个 Go 语言编写的 WhatsApp 桥接程序（whatsapp-bridge）和一个 Python 编写的 MCP 服务器（whatsapp-mcp-server），以及配置示例和说明文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈包括 Go（用于 WhatsApp 桥接，依赖 whatsmeow 库）、Python 3.6+（用于 MCP 服务器）、SQLite（本地存储消息）以及可选的 FFmpeg（用于音频转换）。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上已获得 6420 颗星，本周新增 88 颗，位列 Go 语言周榜第 4 名，因其创新性地将个人通讯工具与 AI 助手结合，并强调本地隐私保护而受到关注。
uses: 希望用 AI 助手管理个人 WhatsApp 消息、自动回复或搜索历史记录的用户。
开发者想要学习如何构建 MCP 服务器或集成 WhatsApp API。
注重隐私、希望数据本地存储且仅按需发送给 LLM 的用户。
需要向群组或个人批量发送媒体文件（如图片、视频、文档）的自动化场景。

en.tag: MCP server that lets AI assistants securely access your personal WhatsApp messages
en.what: This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for WhatsApp that enables AI assistants (like Claude) to search and read your personal WhatsApp messages (including images, videos, documents, and audio), search contacts, and send messages and media to individuals or groups. It connects directly to your personal WhatsApp account via the WhatsApp Web multidevice API, stores all messages locally in a SQLite database, and only sends them to an LLM when the agent accesses them through tools.
en.content: The repository contains a Go-based WhatsApp bridge (whatsapp-bridge) and a Python-based MCP server (whatsapp-mcp-server), along with configuration examples and documentation.
en.stack: Tech stack includes Go (for the WhatsApp bridge, using the whatsmeow library), Python 3.6+ (for the MCP server), SQLite (for local message storage), and optional FFmpeg (for audio conversion).
en.hot: With 6,420 stars and 88 new stars this week, ranking 4th on the Go weekly trending list, it's gaining attention for innovatively bridging personal messaging with AI assistants while emphasizing local privacy.
uses: Users who want to manage personal WhatsApp messages, auto-reply, or search history with an AI assistant.
Developers interested in learning how to build MCP servers or integrate WhatsApp APIs.
Privacy-conscious users who prefer local data storage and only send data to LLMs on demand.
Automation scenarios requiring bulk sending of media files (images, videos, documents) to groups or individuals.

zh.tag: 《塞尔达传说：风之杖》GameCube 版反编译工程
zh.what: 该项目将 GameCube 游戏《塞尔达传说：风之杖》的机器码逆向还原为可读、可编译的 C++ 源代码，目标是产出与原版逐字节一致的构建结果。仓库本身不包含任何游戏素材或汇编，需要用户自备正版游戏镜像。
zh.content: 仓库主要由反编译得到的 C++ 源码、构建脚本（configure.py、ninja 配置）以及 objdiff 比对配置组成，并附带进度徽章与 Discord 社区入口。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 编写，使用 Python 配置脚本与 Ninja 构建系统，并借助 wibo 在非 Windows 平台运行 32 位 Windows 工具链。
zh.hot: 作为经典塞尔达作品的反编译项目，它本周新增 74 星、总数达 1075，登上 GitHub C++ 周榜第 2，反映出复古游戏逆向与 MOD 社区的高涨热情。
uses: 游戏逆向工程爱好者，用于学习大型 C++ 项目的反编译与匹配构建流程
MOD 与 ROM Hack 开发者，可基于可读源码制作补丁和玩法改动
游戏保存与学术研究者，用于研究 GameCube 时代引擎与代码结构

en.tag: A work-in-progress decompilation of The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker for GameCube
en.what: This project reverse-engineers the GameCube title The Legend of Zelda: The Wind Waker back into readable, compilable C++ source code, aiming for a byte-for-byte matching build. The repository ships no game assets or assembly; users must supply their own copy of the game.
en.content: It contains decompiled C++ source, build scripts (configure.py, ninja configs), and objdiff comparison setup, plus progress badges and a Discord community link.
en.stack: Written in C++, it uses Python configuration scripts and the Ninja build system, relying on wibo to run 32-bit Windows tooling on non-Windows platforms.
en.hot: As a decompilation of a classic Zelda title, it gained 74 stars this week for a total of 1,075, ranking #2 on GitHub's weekly C++ trending list, reflecting strong enthusiasm in retro game reverse-engineering and modding communities.
uses: Reverse-engineering enthusiasts learning decompilation and matching-build workflows on a large C++ codebase
Mod and ROM hack developers building patches and gameplay changes on readable source
Game preservationists and researchers studying GameCube-era engine and code structure

zh.tag: 用 C++ 编写的跨平台 PlayStation 4 模拟器
zh.what: shadPS4 是一个用 C++ 编写的早期 PlayStation 4 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 FreeBSD。它专注于模拟 PS4 主机核心，让玩家能在 PC 上运行《血源诅咒》《如龙 0》等独占游戏。
zh.content: 仓库包含模拟器核心代码、构建脚本、文档与截图，但不含图形界面；普通用户需搭配独立的 QtLauncher 使用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 CMake 构建，并涉及 Vulkan 图形后端与各平台系统库。
zh.hot: 作为少有的开源 PS4 模拟器，它已能运行《血源诅咒》等大作，吸引大量玩家关注，星标数已近 3.3 万，今日再登 C++ 日榜。
uses: 想在现代 PC 上重温 PS4 独占游戏的玩家
对主机模拟器开发感兴趣、想研究底层实现的技术爱好者
希望为开源模拟器项目贡献代码或测试兼容性的开发者

en.tag: A cross-platform PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++
en.what: shadPS4 is an early PlayStation 4 emulator written in C++ for Windows, Linux, macOS and FreeBSD. It focuses on emulating the PS4 core, letting players run exclusives like Bloodborne and Yakuza 0 on PC.
en.content: The repo contains the emulator core, build scripts, docs and screenshots, but no GUI; end users need the separate QtLauncher.
en.stack: Primarily C++ with CMake build system, a Vulkan graphics backend and platform-specific system libraries.
en.hot: As one of the few open-source PS4 emulators, it can already run hits like Bloodborne, drawing huge attention with nearly 33k stars and a spot on today's C++ trending list.
uses: Players who want to replay PS4 exclusives on modern PCs
Tech enthusiasts curious about console emulator internals
Developers looking to contribute code or test game compatibility

zh.tag: 实验性 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，跨平台运行 PSV 游戏与自制程序
zh.what: Vita3K 是一个实验性的 PlayStation Vita 模拟器，支持 Windows、Linux、macOS 和 Android。它目前能运行大多数自制程序以及相当数量的商业游戏，并提供官方的兼容性列表供玩家查询。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 C++ 编写的模拟器源码，包含 CPU/GPU 模拟、系统模块等核心组件，另有 README 截图画廊、CI 配置、构建脚本以及面向开发者的 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 开发，依赖 Unicorn 等外部库（因此采用 GPLv2 许可），图形后端支持 OpenGL 或 Vulkan，并配有 GitHub Actions 的 C/C++ CI 流程。
zh.hot: 作为少数仍在活跃开发的 PSV 模拟器，Vita3K 已积累约 5.8k stars，本周新增 44 星并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 分类第 6 名，说明复古掌机模拟社区关注度持续。
uses: 想在 PC 或手机上重温《女神异闻录4 黄金版》等 PSV 游戏的玩家
对掌机模拟器开发、CPU/GPU 模拟技术感兴趣的研究者与开发者
希望测试自制程序或为兼容性列表贡献反馈的 PSV 爱好者

en.tag: Experimental PlayStation Vita emulator running PSV games and homebrew across platforms
en.what: Vita3K is an experimental PlayStation Vita emulator for Windows, Linux, macOS and Android. It currently runs most homebrew programs and a good number of commercial games, with official compatibility lists available for users.
en.content: The repo contains the C++ emulator source with CPU/GPU emulation and system modules, plus a README screenshot gallery, CI configs, build scripts and links to the developer wiki.
en.stack: Written mainly in C++ and depending on external libraries such as Unicorn (hence the GPLv2 license), it supports OpenGL or Vulkan graphics backends and uses GitHub Actions C/C++ CI.
en.hot: As one of the few actively developed PSV emulators, Vita3K has around 5.8k stars, gained 44 this week and ranked 6th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, showing steady interest from the retro handheld emulation community.
uses: Players who want to revisit PSV titles like Persona 4 Golden on PC or mobile
Researchers and developers interested in emulator development and CPU/GPU emulation
PSV enthusiasts who want to test homebrew or contribute compatibility feedback

zh.tag: 跨平台开源游戏串流客户端，支持 NVIDIA GameStream 与 Sunshine
zh.what: Moonlight PC 是一个开源的游戏串流客户端，可以把 PC 上的游戏画面低延迟串流到 Windows、Mac、Linux 以及 Steam Link 等设备上。它既支持 NVIDIA 官方的 GameStream，也支持开源的 Sunshine 串流服务端。
zh.content: 仓库主体是 C++/Qt 编写的桌面客户端源码，包含构建脚本、CI 工作流与多平台打包配置，另有 Weblate 翻译资源和发布用的安装包（Snap、Flatpak、AppImage、Deb 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 与 Qt 框架，依赖 FFmpeg 做硬件加速解码，支持 H.264/HEVC/AV1 编解码，并通过 GitHub Actions 构建多平台产物。
zh.hot: 作为老牌串流方案，Moonlight 在自建云游戏和远程游玩圈子里口碑稳定，近 1.9 万 star 且本周新增 152，说明随着 Sunshine 生态升温仍持续吸引新用户。
uses: 想在电视、笔记本或 Steam Link 上远程玩自己 PC 游戏的玩家
用 Sunshine 自建云游戏/远程串流服务、追求低延迟的折腾党
需要在 Linux、树莓派或 ARM 设备上做游戏串流的开发者与极客
想研究跨平台音视频串流与硬件解码实现的 C++/Qt 开发者

en.tag: Open-source cross-platform game streaming client for NVIDIA GameStream and Sunshine
en.what: Moonlight PC is an open-source game streaming client that lets you play PC games remotely on Windows, Mac, Linux, and Steam Link devices with low latency. It works with both NVIDIA GameStream and the open-source Sunshine host.
en.content: The repo holds the C++/Qt desktop client source, build scripts, CI workflows, and multi-platform packaging configs, plus Weblate translation resources and release artifacts (Snap, Flatpak, AppImage, Deb, etc.).
en.stack: Built mainly with C++ and the Qt framework, relying on FFmpeg for hardware-accelerated decoding, supporting H.264/HEVC/AV1, and using GitHub Actions for multi-platform builds.
en.hot: As a veteran streaming solution, Moonlight has a solid reputation in the self-hosted cloud gaming and remote play community; with nearly 19k stars and 152 added this week, it keeps attracting users as the Sunshine ecosystem grows.
uses: Gamers who want to play their PC games remotely on a TV, laptop, or Steam Link
Enthusiasts self-hosting cloud gaming/remote streaming with Sunshine and low latency
Developers and tinkerers streaming games on Linux, Raspberry Pi, or ARM devices
C++/Qt developers studying cross-platform audio/video streaming and hardware decoding

zh.tag: 基于 Firefox 的极简生产力浏览器
zh.what: Zen Browser 是一个基于 Firefox 内核的开源浏览器，主打「更平静的互联网」体验。它通过垂直标签栏、工作区、分屏等设计，把浏览器变成高效的生产力工具。
zh.content: 仓库包含浏览器桌面端完整源码，涵盖构建脚本、Firefox 补丁、界面主题与文档，并提供 Release 与 Twilight 两条构建通道。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 为主，基于 Firefox 源码树构建，配套 JavaScript/TypeScript 前端界面与 GitHub Actions 自动化构建。
zh.hot: 已获 44836 颗星，本周新增 200，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 C++ 第 13 名，反映出用户对隐私友好、可定制浏览器的强烈需求。
uses: 希望摆脱杂乱标签页、追求专注浏览体验的普通用户
需要多工作区隔离与分屏操作的知识工作者和开发者
关注开源、隐私与可定制性的 Firefox 爱好者
想基于 Firefox 内核二次开发浏览器的技术团队

en.tag: A Firefox-based browser built for calm productivity
en.what: Zen Browser is an open-source browser built on the Firefox engine, aiming for a calmer internet experience. Through vertical tabs, workspaces, and split view, it turns the browser into a productivity tool.
en.content: The repo holds the full desktop browser source, including build scripts, Firefox patches, UI themes, and docs, with Release and Twilight build channels.
en.stack: Primarily C++ built on the Firefox source tree, with JavaScript/TypeScript UI code and GitHub Actions for automated builds.
en.hot: With 44,836 stars and 200 added this week, it ranks 13th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list, reflecting strong demand for privacy-friendly, customizable browsers.
uses: Everyday users who want a focused, clutter-free browsing experience
Knowledge workers and developers needing workspaces and split view
Firefox fans who value open source, privacy, and customization
Teams wanting to build a browser on the Firefox engine

zh.tag: 基于 Vulkan 的 D3D8/9/10/11 转译层，让 Linux/Wine 跑 Windows 3D 游戏
zh.what: DXVK 是一个将 Direct3D 8/9/10/11 调用转译为 Vulkan 的翻译层，使 3D 应用能在 Linux 上通过 Wine 运行。它通过替换 Wine 自带的 wined3d 来提升性能与兼容性，是 Steam Play/Proton 的核心组件之一。
zh.content: 仓库包含 DXVK 的完整 C++ 源码，提供 x64 和 x32 的 DLL 构建（d3d8.dll、d3d9.dll、d3d10core.dll、d3d11.dll、dxgi.dll），以及安装说明、HUD 调试工具和项目 Wiki 链接。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 Vulkan API 和 Wine 环境，构建系统基于 Meson/Ninja，需要较新的 GPU 驱动支持。
zh.hot: DXVK 是 Linux 游戏生态的关键项目，拥有 18,247 颗星，本周新增 75 星，位列 GitHub Trending 周榜（C++）第 10 名，持续受到 Linux 游戏玩家和开发者关注。
uses: Linux 玩家：通过 Wine/Proton 运行 Windows 3D 游戏，提升性能与兼容性。
游戏开发者：测试和调试 Windows 游戏在 Linux 上的表现。
开源贡献者：参与 DXVK 开发，改进 Direct3D 到 Vulkan 的转译。
系统集成者：在 Lutris、Bottles 等工具中集成 DXVK 以简化配置。

en.tag: Vulkan-based translation layer for D3D8/9/10/11, enabling Windows 3D games on Linux/Wine
en.what: DXVK is a translation layer that converts Direct3D 8/9/10/11 calls to Vulkan, allowing 3D applications to run on Linux via Wine. It replaces Wine's built-in wined3d to improve performance and compatibility, and is a core component of Steam Play/Proton.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++ source of DXVK, providing x64 and x32 DLL builds (d3d8.dll, d3d9.dll, d3d10core.dll, d3d11.dll, dxgi.dll), along with installation instructions, HUD debugging tools, and links to the project Wiki.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it depends on the Vulkan API and Wine environment, uses Meson/Ninja as the build system, and requires recent GPU drivers.
en.hot: DXVK is a key project in the Linux gaming ecosystem, with 18,247 stars and 75 new stars this week, ranking 10th on GitHub Trending weekly (C++), continuously attracting attention from Linux gamers and developers.
uses: Linux gamers: run Windows 3D games via Wine/Proton with improved performance and compatibility.
Game developers: test and debug Windows games on Linux.
Open-source contributors: contribute to DXVK development and improve Direct3D-to-Vulkan translation.
System integrators: integrate DXVK in tools like Lutris and Bottles for easier setup.

zh.tag: 每秒解析数 GB JSON 的 SIMD 高性能解析库
zh.what: simdjson 是一个用 C++ 编写的高性能 JSON 解析库，利用 SIMD 指令与微并行算法，解析速度比 RapidJSON 快 4 倍、比 JSON for Modern C++ 快 25 倍。它提供严格的 JSON 与 UTF-8 校验、无损解析，并在运行时自动选择适配 CPU 的解析器。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 C++ 库源码、Doxygen 文档、基准测试与性能数据，以及众多语言绑定和移植版本（如 Python、Rust、Go 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++ 编写，依赖 SIMD 指令集（如 AVX2、SSE4.2、NEON），支持 CMake 构建，并提供多语言绑定。
zh.hot: 凭借每秒解析数 GB 的极致性能，simdjson 被 Node.js、ClickHouse、Meta Velox 等知名项目采用，已获得 24,379 颗星，本周新增 63 星，位列 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 7 名。
uses: 需要高性能 JSON 解析的后端服务与数据库开发者
处理大规模 JSON 数据的实时分析或日志系统
希望集成 SIMD 加速解析的 C++ 项目维护者
对 JSON 解析性能有极致要求的科研与工程团队

en.tag: A SIMD-powered JSON parser that parses gigabytes per second
en.what: simdjson is a high-performance C++ JSON parsing library that uses SIMD instructions and microparallel algorithms to parse JSON 4x faster than RapidJSON and 25x faster than JSON for Modern C++. It offers strict JSON and UTF-8 validation, lossless parsing, and automatically selects a CPU-tailored parser at runtime.
en.content: The repository contains the core C++ library source, Doxygen documentation, benchmarks and performance data, plus numerous language bindings and ports (e.g., Python, Rust, Go).
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, it relies on SIMD instruction sets (e.g., AVX2, SSE4.2, NEON), supports CMake builds, and offers multi-language bindings.
en.hot: With its extreme performance of parsing gigabytes per second, simdjson is adopted by well-known projects like Node.js, ClickHouse, and Meta Velox, earning 24,379 stars with 63 new this week, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending C++ weekly list.
uses: Backend service and database developers needing high-performance JSON parsing
Real-time analytics or logging systems processing large-scale JSON data
C++ project maintainers looking to integrate SIMD-accelerated parsing
Research and engineering teams with extreme JSON parsing performance requirements

zh.tag: 跨平台高级剪贴板管理器，支持脚本与自定义命令
zh.what: CopyQ 是一款跨平台的剪贴板管理器，持续监控系统剪贴板并把内容保存到可自定义的标签页中。它支持文本、HTML、图片及任意自定义格式，并提供强大的编辑、搜索、过滤与脚本自动化能力。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 C++/Qt 源码、构建脚本、多语言翻译文件以及详尽的文档（ReadTheDocs）。同时提供 Linux、Windows、macOS 的安装包与 CI 构建配置。
zh.stack: 基于 C++ 与 Qt 框架开发，使用 CMake 构建，依赖 Qt 的 GUI、网络与脚本模块，并集成 Weblate 翻译与 GitHub Actions 持续集成。
zh.hot: 作为一款成熟稳定的开源剪贴板工具，CopyQ 已积累超过 1.2 万 Star，本周新增 86 星并登上 C++ 周榜第 9 名，说明其在开发者与效率工具爱好者中持续受到关注。
uses: 需要频繁复制粘贴、管理多段剪贴板内容的开发者与文字工作者
希望用脚本自动化剪贴板操作、自定义快捷键的高级用户
在 Linux、Windows 或 macOS 上寻找跨平台剪贴板管理方案的用户

en.tag: Cross-platform advanced clipboard manager with scripting and custom commands
en.what: CopyQ is a cross-platform clipboard manager that monitors the system clipboard and saves its content into customizable tabs. It supports text, HTML, images, and any custom formats, with powerful editing, search, filtering, and scripting automation.
en.content: The repository contains the full C++/Qt source code, build scripts, multi-language translation files, and extensive documentation (ReadTheDocs). It also provides installers for Linux, Windows, and macOS along with CI build configurations.
en.stack: Built with C++ and the Qt framework, using CMake for building, relying on Qt's GUI, network, and scripting modules, with Weblate translations and GitHub Actions CI.
en.hot: As a mature and stable open-source clipboard tool, CopyQ has accumulated over 12,000 stars, gaining 86 stars this week and ranking 9th on the C++ weekly trending list, showing sustained interest from developers and productivity enthusiasts.
uses: Developers and writers who frequently copy/paste and manage multiple clipboard entries
Advanced users who want to automate clipboard operations with scripts and custom shortcuts
Users looking for a cross-platform clipboard manager on Linux, Windows, or macOS

zh.tag: 越狱 PS5 的一体化 HEN 与工具箱
zh.what: OnionHEN 是面向已越狱 PlayStation 5 的模块化 payload 栈，通过一个入口 ELF 完成系统准备、注入 ShellUI 工具箱，并运行各类覆盖层、金手指、payload 与后台服务。它把系统提权、文件系统重挂载、更新分区屏蔽等操作整合进一个实用型自制软件套件。
zh.content: 仓库包含 C/C++ 源码、CMake 构建脚本、资源图片（logo 与截图）以及中英文 README，并配套多个可选外部插件（FTP 服务器、ShadowMount+、DPI v2 等）。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C 与 C++ 编写，采用 CMake 构建，目标平台为 PlayStation 5，遵循 GPLv3 许可证。
zh.hot: 作为 PS5 越狱生态中少见的“一体化 HEN + 工具箱”方案，它把提权、插件运行时、金手指和游戏覆盖层打包在一起，本周新增 92 星、总计 360 星，登上 GitHub Trending C++ 周榜第 13 名。
uses: 已越狱 PS5 主机用户，希望一站式管理 payload、插件与系统设置
需要游戏内 FPS/温度监控与金手指功能的玩家
想通过 FTP、Remote Play 或外部 HDD 扩展主机功能的折腾党
关注 PS5 自制软件与越狱工具链开发的 C/C++ 开发者

en.tag: An all-in-one HEN and Toolbox for jailbroken PS5
en.what: OnionHEN is a modular payload stack for jailbroken PlayStation 5 consoles. A single entry ELF prepares the system, injects a ShellUI Toolbox, and then runs overlays, cheats, payloads, and background services.
en.content: The repo contains C/C++ sources, CMake build scripts, asset images (logo and screenshots), bilingual READMEs, plus several optional external plugins such as the FTP server, ShadowMount+, and DPI v2.
en.stack: Written mainly in C and C++, built with CMake, targeting the PlayStation 5 platform, and licensed under GPLv3.
en.hot: As a rare all-in-one HEN plus toolbox for the PS5 jailbreak scene, it bundles privilege escalation, a plugin runtime, cheats, and a game overlay, gaining 92 stars this week for a total of 360 and ranking 13th on GitHub Trending's weekly C++ list.
uses: Jailbroken PS5 owners who want one-stop management of payloads, plugins, and system settings
Gamers who need in-game FPS/temperature monitoring and cheat engine features
Tinkerers wanting to extend their console via FTP, Remote Play, or external HDD
C/C++ developers interested in PS5 homebrew and jailbreak toolchain development

zh.tag: 本地优先的全能语音工作室
zh.what: VoiceStudio 是一个开源的、完全本地运行的语音工具集，提供类似 ElevenLabs 的功能，包括声音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录和有声书制作，支持 646 种语言。无需账户、API 密钥或订阅，所有处理都在用户自己的硬件上完成。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的应用代码、文档、安装指南、架构说明和 API 文档，支持 macOS、Windows、Linux 及 Docker。集成了 16 种 TTS 引擎和 11 种 ASR 引擎，提供图形界面和命令行工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Python 构建，依赖多种开源 TTS/ASR 引擎（如 Coqui、Whisper 等），支持跨平台桌面环境与 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 作为本地优先的 ElevenLabs 替代品，VoiceStudio 在隐私和成本敏感的用户中迅速走红，单日新增 1672 星，总星数达 16279，反映出对自主语音处理工具的高需求。
uses: 内容创作者：需要为视频配音或制作多语言音频，但不想依赖云服务。
隐私敏感用户：希望语音数据完全留在本地，避免上传到第三方。
开发者：需要集成语音克隆或转录功能的 API，且要求离线运行。
语言学习者：利用 646 种语言支持进行听力练习或生成自定义语音内容。

en.tag: Fully-local voice studio: clone, dub, transcribe & more
en.what: VoiceStudio is an open-source, fully-local voice toolkit offering ElevenLabs-like features: voice cloning, voice design, video dubbing, dictation, transcription, and audiobook creation across 646 languages. No account, API key, or subscription required—everything runs on your own hardware.
en.content: The repository includes full application code, docs, installation guides, architecture, and API docs, supporting macOS, Windows, Linux, and Docker. It integrates 16 TTS engines and 11 ASR engines, offering both GUI and CLI tools.
en.stack: Built primarily with Python, leveraging various open-source TTS/ASR engines (e.g., Coqui, Whisper), with cross-platform desktop support and Docker deployment.
en.hot: As a local-first ElevenLabs alternative, VoiceStudio is gaining rapid traction among privacy- and cost-conscious users, adding 1,672 stars in a day to reach 16,279 total, reflecting high demand for self-hosted voice tools.
uses: Content creators needing video dubbing or multilingual audio without cloud dependency.
Privacy-conscious users who want voice data to stay entirely on-device.
Developers seeking offline APIs for voice cloning or transcription integration.
Language learners leveraging 646-language support for listening practice or custom audio.

zh.tag: 面向投行、研究与财富管理的金融工作流 AI 代理与技能库
zh.what: 这是 Anthropic 官方开源的金融行业 AI 代理参考实现，覆盖投行、股票研究、私募股权和财富管理等场景。它把同一套系统提示词和技能以两种方式交付：作为 Claude Cowork 插件安装，或通过 Claude Managed Agents API 部署到自有工作流引擎中。
zh.content: 仓库包含两类内容：一是具名端到端代理（Pitch Agent、Market Researcher、GL Reconciler、Month-End Closer 等），每个都自带技能并同时提供 Cowork 插件和 Managed Agent 模板；二是按金融垂直领域打包的底层技能、斜杠命令和数据连接器（如 /comps、/dcf、/earnings）。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，依赖 Claude Cowork 插件体系与 Claude Managed Agents API（/v1/agents）进行部署。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方发布的金融垂直代理库，它把大模型代理直接落到投行、PE 等高价值工作流，上线即冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 5，今日新增 260 star，总 star 已达 35370。
uses: 投行、PE、股票研究与财富管理从业者，用于加速建模、备忘录与研究报告草拟
金融机构的 AI/平台工程团队，希望基于官方模板搭建自有代理工作流
需要 /comps、/dcf、/earnings 等金融技能与数据连接器的开发者
关注合规与人工复核流程、想评估 LLM 代理在金融场景落地边界的研究者

en.tag: Reference agents, skills, and data connectors for financial-services workflows
en.what: Anthropic's open-source reference implementation of AI agents for financial services, covering investment banking, equity research, private equity, and wealth management. The same system prompts and skills ship two ways: as a Claude Cowork plugin, or deployed via the Claude Managed Agents API behind your own workflow engine.
en.content: It contains two layers: named end-to-end agents (Pitch Agent, Market Researcher, GL Reconciler, Month-End Closer, etc.), each self-contained with bundled skills and shipped both as a Cowork plugin and a Managed Agent template; and vertical plugins bundling underlying skills, slash commands, and data connectors such as /comps, /dcf, and /earnings.
en.stack: Primary language is Python, built around the Claude Cowork plugin system and the Claude Managed Agents API (/v1/agents) for deployment.
en.hot: As Anthropic's official vertical agent library for finance, it lands LLM agents directly in high-value workflows like investment banking and PE, debuting at #5 on GitHub Trending with 260 stars added today and 35,370 total.
uses: Investment banking, PE, equity research, and wealth management professionals drafting models, memos, and research notes
Financial-institution AI/platform teams building custom agent workflows on official templates
Developers needing finance skills and data connectors like /comps, /dcf, and /earnings
Researchers assessing compliance and human-in-the-loop boundaries for LLM agents in finance

zh.tag: 开源AI代理团队管理平台，像运营公司一样管理代理。

zh.stack: 主要使用 TypeScript，基于 Node.js 和 React 构建，依赖现代前端和后端技术。
zh.hot: 凭借 84963 颗星和今日新增 2109 星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第一，反映出对 AI 代理团队管理工具的强烈需求。

创业公司 —— 想用 AI 代理自动化运营，从目标设定到执行监控。

产品经理 —— 通过仪表板监控代理工作，确保与业务目标对齐。

en.tag: Open-source orchestration for teams of AI agents, manage like a company.
en.what: Paperclip is an open-source app for managing AI agent teams at work. It orchestrates multiple agents via a Node.js server and React UI, letting users set business goals, assign tasks, and track work and costs.
en.content: The repo includes a Node.js server and React frontend, offering dashboards, org charts, budgets, and governance, with support for multiple agent providers.

en.hot: With 84,963 stars and 2,109 added today, it tops GitHub Trending daily, reflecting strong demand for AI agent team management tools.

Startups — want to automate operations with AI agents, from goal setting to execution monitoring.
Developers — wish to integrate various agent providers and build custom workflows.
Product managers — monitor agent work via dashboard to ensure alignment with business goals.

zh.tag: 为 Claude Code 等 AI 编码代理打造的性能优化与安全增强系统
zh.what: ECC 是一个代理工具链（harness）优化系统，为 Claude Code、Codex、Opencode、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理提供技能、直觉、记忆、安全与研究优先的开发能力。它通过统一的配置与插件机制，增强代理在复杂任务中的表现与可控性。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 JavaScript 库、CLI 工具、GitHub App（ecc-tools）、文档（多语言 README）以及示例配置，支持通过 npm 包（ecc-universal）集成。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript/Node.js，依赖 npm 生态，提供 CLI 与 GitHub App 集成，支持多代理框架（Claude Code、Codex 等）。
zh.hot: 凭借 24.4 万 Star 和今日新增 235 星，ECC 成为 AI 代理工具链领域的明星项目，其跨代理兼容性和性能优化特性吸引了大量开发者关注。
uses: AI 编码代理用户：希望增强 Claude Code、Codex 等代理的记忆、安全与技能，提升开发效率。
团队与组织：需要统一管理多个 AI 代理的配置、权限与安全策略，确保合规与可控。
开发者工具链爱好者：对代理性能优化、插件机制和 GitHub App 集成感兴趣，可扩展自定义功能。

en.tag: Performance optimization and security enhancement system for AI coding agents like Claude Code
en.what: ECC is an agent harness optimization system that provides skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development capabilities for AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It enhances agent performance and control through unified configuration and plugin mechanisms.
en.content: The repository includes core JavaScript libraries, CLI tools, a GitHub App (ecc-tools), multi-language documentation, and example configurations, integrable via the npm package (ecc-universal).
en.stack: Built on JavaScript/Node.js, leveraging the npm ecosystem, offering CLI and GitHub App integration, compatible with multiple agent frameworks (Claude Code, Codex, etc.).
en.hot: With 244k stars and 235 new stars today, ECC has become a star project in the AI agent toolchain space, attracting developers with its cross-agent compatibility and performance optimization features.
uses: AI coding agent users: Enhance memory, security, and skills for agents like Claude Code and Codex to boost development productivity.
Teams and organizations: Need unified management of configurations, permissions, and security policies across multiple AI agents for compliance and control.
Developer toolchain enthusiasts: Interested in agent performance optimization, plugin mechanisms, and GitHub App integration for custom extensions.

zh.tag: 浏览器里的实时全球态势感知模拟器
zh.what: 这是一个在浏览器中运行的间谍卫星模拟器，但数据是真实的。它在一个逼真的3D地球上实时展示飞机、船舶、卫星、地震、交通和公共摄像头等公开信号，并支持语音控制。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的Web应用源码，包括3D地球渲染、实时数据图层、语音控制AI代理、以及清晰的标注（如模拟与实时区分）。
zh.stack: 主要使用JavaScript，可能涉及Three.js或类似3D库、WebSocket实时数据、语音识别API等。
zh.hot: 该项目在GitHub Trending日榜排名第一，今日新增近2000星，因其独特的'真实数据间谍卫星'概念和病毒式传播的YouTube系列而迅速走红。
uses: 对开源情报、地理空间数据可视化感兴趣的开发者或研究者。
希望体验实时全球动态（航班、船舶、卫星等）的科技爱好者。
教育场景中用于演示实时数据源和3D可视化技术。

en.tag: A real-time global situational awareness simulator in your browser
en.what: A spy-satellite simulator in your browser with real data. It visualizes live aircraft, ships, satellites, earthquakes, traffic, and public cameras on a photorealistic 3D globe, with hands-free voice control.
en.content: The repo contains the full web app source code, including 3D globe rendering, live data layers, a voice-controlled AI agent, and clear labeling of simulated vs. live feeds.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, likely using Three.js or similar 3D libraries, WebSocket for real-time data, and speech recognition APIs.
en.hot: Ranked #1 on GitHub Trending daily with ~2,000 stars added today, it went viral due to its unique 'real-data spy satellite' concept and the popular YouTube series behind it.
uses: Developers or researchers interested in open-source intelligence and geospatial data visualization.
Tech enthusiasts who want to experience real-time global dynamics (flights, ships, satellites, etc.).
Educational settings for demonstrating real-time data sources and 3D visualization techniques.

zh.tag: 让智能体真正学会学习的长期记忆系统
zh.what: Hindsight 是一个面向 AI 智能体的记忆系统，目标不是简单回放对话历史，而是让智能体随时间积累经验、持续学习。它声称克服了 RAG 和知识图谱在长期记忆任务上的缺陷，并在相关基准上达到领先水平。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 服务端与客户端 SDK、NPM 客户端包、文档站点（hindsight-docs）、集成示例与 Cookbook，并提供 MCP 服务器、LLM Wrapper 及编码智能体接入方式。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，发布到 PyPI（hindsight-api、hindsight-client）与 NPM（@vectorize-io/hindsight-client），采用 MIT 许可，支持独立服务器、嵌入式运行及多种平台集成。
zh.hot: 上线即获 27785 颗星、单日新增 1668 星并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2，说明智能体长期记忆正是当下最受关注的痛点方向。
uses: 构建需要跨会话记住用户偏好并持续进化的 AI 智能体开发者
希望替代 RAG 或知识图谱方案、提升长期记忆准确率的团队
为编码助手、客服机器人等产品接入记忆能力的工程团队
想通过 MCP 或 LLM Wrapper 快速试水智能体记忆的研究者

en.tag: Agent memory system that makes agents learn, not just remember
en.what: Hindsight is an agent memory system designed to make agents learn over time rather than merely recall conversation history. It claims to overcome the shortcomings of RAG and knowledge graphs, delivering state-of-the-art results on long-term memory benchmarks.
en.content: The repo ships a Python server and client SDK, an NPM client package, a docs site (hindsight-docs), integration examples and a cookbook, plus an MCP server, an LLM wrapper, and coding-agent integrations.
en.stack: Primarily Python, published on PyPI (hindsight-api, hindsight-client) and NPM (@vectorize-io/hindsight-client) under MIT license, supporting standalone server, embedded mode, and multi-platform integrations.
en.hot: With 27,785 stars and 1,668 added in a single day, ranking #2 on GitHub Trending daily, it shows agent long-term memory is one of today's hottest pain points.
uses: Developers building AI agents that must remember user preferences across sessions and keep improving
Teams looking to replace RAG or knowledge-graph approaches with higher long-term memory accuracy
Engineering teams adding memory to coding assistants, support bots, and similar products
Researchers wanting to try agent memory quickly via MCP or the LLM wrapper

zh.tag: 终端里的智能体编程助手，用自然语言写代码
zh.what: Claude Code 是 Anthropic 推出的智能体编程工具，常驻终端，能理解你的代码库。它通过自然语言指令执行日常任务、解释复杂代码并处理 git 工作流，帮助开发者更快编码。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含安装脚本、插件目录（提供自定义命令与智能体扩展）以及演示动图，官方文档托管在外部站点。
zh.stack: 核心以 TypeScript 编写，要求 Node.js 18+，支持 curl、Homebrew、WinGet、PowerShell 等多种安装方式（npm 已弃用）。
zh.hot: 作为 Anthropic 官方出品的智能体编程工具，它已积累 145,507 颗星，今日再增 165 星并登上日榜第 11 名，持续吸引开发者关注。
uses: 希望用自然语言加速日常编码与重构的开发者
需要在终端内处理 git 工作流和代码解释的工程师
想通过插件扩展自定义命令与智能体的进阶用户

en.tag: An agentic coding tool living in your terminal, coding via natural language
en.what: Claude Code is Anthropic's agentic coding tool that lives in your terminal and understands your codebase. It executes routine tasks, explains complex code, and handles git workflows through natural language commands, helping developers code faster.
en.content: The repo mainly contains install scripts, a plugins directory (offering custom commands and agent extensions), and a demo GIF, with official docs hosted externally.
en.stack: Written primarily in TypeScript, it requires Node.js 18+ and supports multiple install methods like curl, Homebrew, WinGet, and PowerShell (npm is deprecated).
en.hot: As Anthropic's official agentic coding tool, it has amassed 145,507 stars, gaining 165 more today and ranking 11th on the daily trending list, drawing steady developer attention.
uses: Developers who want to speed up daily coding and refactoring with natural language
Engineers handling git workflows and code explanations inside the terminal
Advanced users extending custom commands and agents via plugins

zh.tag: 腾讯云开源的自托管多用户多智能体 AI 助手
zh.what: Octop 是腾讯云开源的自托管 AI 助手，主打多用户与多智能体并行协作，可为团队、家庭和个人搭建独立又协同的智能环境。它完全运行在本地，隐私不外泄，单进程启动即可用。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Python 3.12+ 的完整实现，提供 Web 控制台、CLI 与 IM 集成，并有专家库、Connectors（OAuth + MCP）和 ACP 等扩展模块，附中英文 README 与路线图。
zh.stack: 基于 Python 3.12+，采用 Ruff 代码风格，通过 PyPI 分发，支持 HTTP/SSE/WebSocket 接口，并集成 MCP、OAuth 与 ACP 协议。
zh.hot: 上线即冲上 GitHub Trending Python 日榜第 6，累计约 2950 star、单日新增 396，腾讯云背书加上自托管多智能体定位正好切中隐私与协作需求。
uses: 注重数据隐私、希望本地自托管 AI 助手的团队与个人
需要多用户共享、多智能体协作的家庭或小型组织
想通过飞书、钉钉、QQ、Discord、企业微信等 IM 接入 AI 的用户
希望用专家库、Connectors 与 ACP 扩展 IDE 工作流的开发者

en.tag: Tencent Cloud's self-hosted multi-user, multi-agent AI assistant
en.what: Octop is an open-source, self-hosted AI assistant from Tencent Cloud built around multi-user and multi-agent parallelism, creating an intelligent environment that is both independent and collaborative for teams, families, and individuals. It runs entirely on your own machine, so privacy is never compromised, and a single process brings up the whole stack.
en.content: The repo ships a full Python 3.12+ implementation with a web console, CLI and IM integrations, plus extension modules such as an expert library, Connectors (OAuth + MCP) and ACP, along with bilingual READMEs and a roadmap.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+, styled with Ruff and distributed via PyPI, it exposes HTTP/SSE/WebSocket interfaces and integrates MCP, OAuth and ACP protocols.
en.hot: It hit No.6 on GitHub Trending's Python daily list with roughly 2,950 stars and 396 gained in a single day, as Tencent Cloud's backing plus a self-hosted multi-agent angle taps straight into privacy and collaboration needs.
uses: Teams and individuals who value privacy and want a self-hosted AI assistant
Families or small organizations needing multi-user sharing and multi-agent collaboration
Users who want AI access via Feishu, DingTalk, QQ, Discord or WeCom
Developers extending IDE workflows with the expert library, Connectors and ACP

zh.tag: 面向自主智能体的高密度安全沙箱运行时
zh.what: Agent Substrate 是一个默认安全的智能体执行运行时，能在标准容器运行时基础上以 10 倍密度运行数百万个沙箱。它把大量「actor」（如智能体应用）映射到少量就绪的「worker」上，利用智能体大部分时间空闲的特性实现重度多路复用，并支持 microVM、gVisor 等多种沙箱技术。
zh.content: 仓库包含用 Go 编写的核心系统，提供 actor 生命周期管理（创建/销毁、挂起/恢复）、实时调度到 worker 以及流量路由；还附带演示视频和集群复现指南，展示约 250 个有状态 actor 在 8 个物理 Pod 上的多路复用。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，底层依赖 Kubernetes 进行基础设施供给和 worker（Pod）生命周期管理，并集成 microVM、gVisor 等沙箱技术，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 今日新增 498 星、总星数 2606，登上 GitHub Trending Go 日榜第 4 名；其「10 倍密度、亚 500ms 恢复、每秒 500+ 挂起/恢复」的指标切中了智能体规模化运行的基础设施痛点。
uses: 需要大规模运行自主智能体、追求高密度与低延迟的 AI 基础设施团队
在 Kubernetes 上构建端到端智能体部署、希望统一调度与隔离的平台工程师
研究 RL 场景中智能体、推理与训练循环协同优化的研究人员
关注零信任内核与网络隔离、需要安全沙箱运行不可信代码的开发者

en.tag: A secure-by-default, high-density sandbox runtime for autonomous agents
en.what: Agent Substrate is a secure-by-default agent execution runtime engineered to run millions of sandboxes at 10x the density of standard container runtimes. It maps many 'actors' (agent-like applications) onto a smaller pool of ready 'workers', exploiting the fact that agents are idle most of the time to achieve heavy multiplexing, and supports multiple sandbox technologies including microVMs and gVisor.
en.content: The repo contains the Go-based core system offering actor lifecycle management (create/destroy, suspend/resume), real-time assignment to workers, and traffic routing, plus a demo video and cluster walkthrough showing ~250 stateful actors multiplexed across 8 physical pods.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it builds on Kubernetes for infrastructure provisioning and worker (Pod) lifecycle management, integrates sandbox technologies like microVMs and gVisor, and is licensed under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It gained 498 stars today (2,606 total) and ranked #4 on GitHub Trending's Go daily list; its metrics—10x density, sub-500ms resume, and 500+ suspend/resume activations per second—hit the infrastructure pain point of running agents at scale.
uses: AI infrastructure teams needing to run autonomous agents at scale with high density and low latency
Platform engineers building end-to-end agent deployments on Kubernetes who want unified scheduling and isolation
Researchers optimizing RL scenarios that span agentic, inference, and training cycles
Developers needing secure sandboxes with zero-trust kernel and network isolation for untrusted code

zh.tag: 纯 C 无依赖，从磁盘流式加载专家，在自有硬件上跑前沿 MoE 大模型
zh.what: colibri 是一个用纯 C 编写的极简推理引擎，让普通电脑也能运行数百亿参数级别的开源 MoE 大模型。它利用 MoE 每个 token 只激活一小部分专家的特性，把常驻部分放在内存、其余专家按需从磁盘流式读取，因此无需 GPU。
zh.content: 仓库按模型家族组织，每个家族一个 C 文件，目前包含 13 个引擎：10 个语言模型引擎（GLM、Kimi、DeepSeek、Qwen、OLMoE 等）、1 个图像引擎（Qwen-Image）和 2 个决策模型引擎，另有网站、多语言 README 与一键启动脚本。
zh.stack: 纯 C 实现，无外部依赖，仅需 8GB 以上内存、约 22GB 磁盘空间和 Python 构建脚本；支持 Windows、Linux、macOS，GPU 可选。
zh.hot: 本月新增 13446 star、总数突破 4 万，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜第 18 名；它把「本地跑百亿级 MoE」从口号变成一行命令，直击显存焦虑与隐私需求。
uses: 想在普通笔记本或旧台式机上本地体验大模型的开发者
关注隐私、不愿把数据发给云端 API 的个人与团队
研究 MoE 推理与磁盘流式加载机制的系统工程师
需要低成本离线部署语言、图像或决策模型的爱好者

en.tag: Pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk — run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own
en.what: colibri is a tiny pure-C inference engine that runs very large open MoE models on ordinary machines. Exploiting the fact that a mixture-of-experts model only uses a small part of itself per token, it keeps that part in RAM and streams the remaining experts from disk, so no GPU is required.
en.content: The repo is organized one C file per model family, shipping 13 engines today: ten for language models (GLM, Kimi, DeepSeek, Qwen, OLMoE and more), one for images (Qwen-Image) and two decision models, plus a website, multilingual READMEs and one-step launch scripts.
en.stack: Written in pure C with zero dependencies; needs 8GB+ RAM, about 22GB free disk and Python for the build script, and runs on Windows, Linux and macOS with an optional GPU.
en.hot: It gained 13,446 stars this month for a total past 40k, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending monthly; it turns 'run hundred-billion-parameter MoE locally' into a single command, hitting both VRAM anxiety and privacy needs.
uses: Developers who want to run large models locally on a laptop or older desktop
Individuals and teams with privacy concerns who avoid cloud APIs
Systems engineers studying MoE inference and disk-streaming techniques
Hobbyists needing low-cost offline language, image or decision models

zh.tag: 为 AI 编码代理压缩上下文窗口、沙箱化工具输出并持久化会话记忆
zh.what: Context Mode 是面向 AI 编码代理的上下文优化层，把工具输出放进沙箱处理，官方称可减少约 98% 的上下文占用。它同时持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上统一路由，让代理在长任务中不丢状态、不爆窗口。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 实现，核心是 MCP 服务与 hooks 集成，附带 npm 包、插件市场入口、统计脚本与 Discord 社区链接。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，依赖 MCP 协议与各代理平台的 hooks 机制，通过 npm 分发，采用 ELv2 许可。
zh.hot: 月增 4034 star、总量 24069，登上 GitHub Trending TypeScript 月榜第 14，并在 Hacker News 拿到 570+ 分的第一名，上下文成本是当下代理开发最痛的议题。
uses: 重度使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等编码代理、常被上下文窗口限制的开发者
需要跨多个平台统一管理代理会话与记忆的团队
希望降低工具输出 token 成本、控制 API 账单的工程团队
为代理工具链做集成、想接入 MCP 生态的插件作者

en.tag: Context window optimization for AI coding agents: sandbox tool output, persist memory, route across platforms
en.what: Context Mode is a context-optimization layer for AI coding agents that sandboxes tool output, claiming roughly a 98% reduction in context usage. It also persists session memory and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP and hooks, so agents keep state without blowing the window.
en.content: The repo is TypeScript-based, centered on an MCP server plus hook integrations, with an npm package, marketplace entry, stats script, and Discord community links.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, built on the MCP protocol and platform hook systems, distributed via npm under the ELv2 license.
en.hot: With 24,069 stars and 4,034 added this month, it ranks 14th on GitHub Trending's TypeScript monthly list and hit #1 on Hacker News with 570+ points — context cost is the sharpest pain in agent development right now.
uses: Developers who lean on Claude Code, Cursor, and similar agents and keep hitting context limits
Teams needing unified session memory and routing across multiple agent platforms
Engineering teams trying to cut tool-output token costs and API bills
Toolchain integrators and plugin authors building on the MCP ecosystem

zh.tag: 给 AI 代理一台可用的电脑：开源驱动、跨系统机群与评测基准
zh.what: Cua 是一套面向 computer-use 代理的开源基础设施，让 AI 代理能像人一样操作桌面应用。它提供桌面自动化驱动、隔离的云端桌面机群、本地 macOS 虚拟机、专用决策模型以及评测基准，覆盖训练、评估与数据生成全流程。
zh.content: 仓库按模块组织：Cua Driver（跨 macOS/Windows/Linux 的应用操作驱动）、Cua Fleets（隔离云桌面）、Lume（Apple Silicon 上的本地 macOS/Linux 虚拟机）、CUA-S1 小模型以及 Cua Bench 评测工具，另含文档与示例。
zh.stack: 以 HTML 为主要呈现语言，核心为 Python/TypeScript SDK，依赖虚拟化（Apple Silicon 上的 Lume）、容器化云桌面与多模态模型推理；提供 Docker 与云端部署路径。
zh.hot: 本周新增 1211 star、总数突破 2.7 万并登上 GitHub Trending 周榜第 15，说明 computer-use 代理正从演示走向可规模化的基础设施，开发者对开源替代方案需求强烈。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为代理接入真实桌面操作能力与评测闭环
研究者：用 Cua Bench 生成轨迹数据、评估 computer-use 模型
企业团队：在隔离云桌面上批量运行自动化任务与回归测试
Mac 用户：用 Lume 在 Apple Silicon 上跑本地 macOS/Linux 虚拟机

en.tag: Give AI agents computers they can use: open-source drivers, cross-OS fleets, and benchmarks
en.what: Cua is an open-source infrastructure stack for computer-use agents, letting AI agents operate desktop applications like a human. It ships desktop automation drivers, isolated cloud desktop fleets, local macOS VMs, specialist decision models, and benchmarks spanning training, evaluation, and data generation.
en.content: The repo is organized into modules: Cua Driver (cross-platform app operation on macOS/Windows/Linux), Cua Fleets (isolated cloud desktops), Lume (local macOS/Linux VMs on Apple Silicon), the CUA-S1 small model, and Cua Bench for evaluation, plus docs and examples.
en.stack: HTML-heavy presentation with Python/TypeScript SDKs at the core, relying on virtualization (Lume on Apple Silicon), containerized cloud desktops, and multimodal model inference; offers Docker and cloud deployment paths.
en.hot: With 1,211 stars added this week, a total past 27k, and a #15 spot on the GitHub Trending weekly chart, it shows computer-use agents moving from demos to scalable infrastructure and strong demand for open-source alternatives.
uses: AI agent developers: give agents real desktop control plus an evaluation loop
Researchers: generate trajectory data and benchmark computer-use models with Cua Bench
Enterprise teams: run automation and regression tests at scale on isolated cloud desktops
Mac users: run local macOS/Linux VMs on Apple Silicon with Lume

zh.tag: 面向并行 AI 代理工作流的 Git worktree 管理 CLI
zh.what: Worktrunk 是一个用 Rust 编写的命令行工具，用于管理 Git worktree，让开发者可以在同一仓库中并行维护多个工作目录。它专为并行 AI 代理工作流设计，使多个代理或任务能各自在独立工作区中同时运行而不互相干扰。
zh.content: 仓库以 Rust 源码为主体，包含 CLI 命令实现、文档站点（worktrunk.dev）与 CI/Codecov 配置，并提供 crate 发布形态。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写，通过 Cargo/crates.io 分发，采用 MIT 或 Apache-2.0 双许可，并配有 GitHub Actions CI 与 Codecov 覆盖率检测。
zh.hot: 项目已获得约 6984 颗星，今日新增 44 星并登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 18 名，说明在 AI 代理并行开发这一热点方向上需求旺盛。
uses: 需要同时运行多个 AI 编码代理的开发者，用独立 worktree 隔离各自任务
在本地并行开发多个分支或功能、频繁切换上下文的工程师

zh.tag: 用树形索引与推理取代向量检索的无向量 RAG 方案
zh.what: PageIndex 是一个面向长文档与专业文档的 RAG 框架，主张「相似度不等于相关性」，用 LLM 推理替代向量相似度检索。它先为每篇文档生成层级树状索引，再让智能体在树上推理式地定位并阅读正确章节，像人类专家翻阅长报告那样完成检索。
zh.content: 仓库以 Python 实现为主，包含 PageIndex SDK（pip 安装，支持本地模式与云端模式）、面向文本 PDF 的快速树索引生成器 PageIndex Flash、可扩展到百万文档的文件系统级索引层，以及长文档分析应用 PageIndex App。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Python，通过 pip 安装 pageindex 包；本地模式需自备 LLM API Key，也可切换到 PageIndex Cloud 使用 API Key，配套网站、文档与博客。
zh.hot: 项目已积累 37390 颗星，今日新增 835 星并冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 11 名，说明「无向量、无分块、靠推理检索」这一反主流思路正切中长文档 RAG 精度痛点。
uses: 需要处理合同、财报、论文等长专业文档的 RAG 开发者
对向量检索精度不满、想尝试推理式检索的研究与工程团队
希望本地私有化部署文档索引与问答的企业用户
想了解无向量 RAG 架构思路的 AI 应用学习者

en.tag: Vectorless, reasoning-based RAG that replaces vector search with a hierarchical tree index
en.what: PageIndex is a RAG framework for long, professional documents that argues similarity is not relevance, replacing vector similarity search with LLM reasoning. It first builds a hierarchical tree index for each document, then lets an agent reason its way through that tree to find and read the right section, much like a human expert navigating a long report.
en.content: The repo is primarily Python and ships the PageIndex SDK (pip-installable, with local and cloud modes), PageIndex Flash for fast tree index generation on text-based PDFs, a file-level indexing layer that scales to millions of documents, and the PageIndex App for long-document analysis.
en.stack: Written in Python and installed via pip as the pageindex package; local mode requires your own LLM API key, while the same client can point at PageIndex Cloud with an API key, backed by a website, docs, and blog.
en.hot: With 37,390 stars and 835 added today, landing at #11 on GitHub Trending, it shows the contrarian 'no vector DB, no chunking, reasoning-based retrieval' idea resonates with pain points in long-document RAG accuracy.
uses: RAG developers working with long professional documents like contracts, financial reports, and papers
Research and engineering teams frustrated with vector retrieval accuracy who want reasoning-based retrieval
Enterprises needing locally deployed, private document indexing and Q&A
AI application learners curious about vectorless RAG architectures

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的工具版 OpenRouter，一个令牌调用 3000+ 工具端点

自托管用户：需要私有化部署工具网关并掌控凭证与计费

en.tag: OpenRouter for agent tools — one token, 3,000+ tool endpoints

en.stack: Written mainly in Python; it proxies upstream requests over HTTP and injects credentials server-side, with a shell-installed CLI, hosted on Render.
en.hot: It quickly reached 3,164 stars with 468 added today, ranking 13th on GitHub Trending daily, hitting the pain of fragmented, expensive agent tool access.

Indie developers and small teams unwilling to buy pricey Semrush or Apollo subscriptions for a single run
Enterprise teams wanting to manage their own API keys, CLIs, and SKILL.md files securely across all agents
Self-hosters who need a private tool gateway with full control over credentials and billing

zh.tag: AI 代理技能安装前的安全扫描器

en.tag: Security scanner for AI agent skills before installation

en.content: The repo contains the Python scanner source, analysis rules for 71 vulnerability patterns, a two-stage analysis pipeline, multi-format report output, and docs covering development, resource bounds, Pi/OpenCode extensions, and false-positive suppression.
en.stack: Built on Python 3.12+ under Apache 2.0, combining static analysis, AST, taint tracking, YARA signatures, optional LLM semantic evaluation, and live CVE lookups via OSV.dev.
en.hot: As the agent-skill ecosystem explodes, its research showing 26.1% of 31,132 skills contain vulnerabilities and 5.2% show likely malicious intent addresses a pressing pre-install security need, propelling it to No.5 on GitHub's Python daily trending with 17,770 stars.
uses: AI agent users: vet Claude Code, Codex, or MCP skills before installing them
Platform and security teams: build scanning, signing, and gating pipelines for skill marketplaces
Developers: integrate SARIF/JSON reports into CI to block supply-chain risks
Security researchers: study agent-specific attack surfaces like prompt injection and data exfiltration

en.hot: As one of the dominant AI frameworks, PyTorch has over 103k stars, gained 205 this week and ranked 17th on GitHub Trending's Python weekly list, riding the LLM and generative AI wave.

zh.tag: NVIDIA 官方模型压缩与推理加速统一库

en.tag: NVIDIA's unified library for model compression and inference acceleration
