en.content: The repo contains Python APIs, implementations of optimization algorithms such as quantization and distillation, example tutorials (e.g., an end-to-end NVFP4 W4A4 + QAD tutorial for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B), documentation source, and integrations for Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM, and Hugging Face Accelerate.
en.stack: Primarily Python, depending on PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers/Accelerate, and ONNX, with deep integration into the NVIDIA ecosystem including Megatron-Bridge, Megatron-LM, TensorRT-LLM, TensorRT, vLLM, and SGLang.
en.hot: As an official NVIDIA library, it bridges training and deployment quantization pipelines for TensorRT-LLM/vLLM, meeting the pressing need to cut LLM inference costs. It gained 44 stars today to rank #5 on GitHub Trending, with about 4,081 stars total.
uses: LLM inference deployment engineers who need to quantize models for TensorRT-LLM, vLLM, and similar frameworks
Model compression and optimization researchers reproducing SOTA quantization, distillation, pruning, and NAS techniques
Teams in the NVIDIA GPU ecosystem adding quantization-aware training to Megatron or Hugging Face pipelines

zh.tag: 把 ChatGPT 网页版（含 Pro）接入 Codex 原生模型选择器，不消耗 Codex 额度
zh.what: 这是一个让 Codex 直接调用 ChatGPT 网页版模型的桥接工具，包括 Pro 档位，走 ChatGPT 网页版独立的用量额度，不占用 Work 或 Codex 配额。它保留 Codex 原有界面、任务、图片与流式输出，并通过 MCP 的 Full harness 模式把当前任务的文件夹、终端、工具和审批流程接给 ChatGPT。
zh.content: 仓库提供 Windows/macOS/Linux 三平台启动器安装包（exe/dmg/AppImage），内置浏览器与运行时，无需另装 Chrome、Node 或 Bun；另含架构文档、故障排查文档和多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，通过 MCP 与 Codex 集成，内置浏览器运行时用于登录 ChatGPT 网页版；提供终端安装、更新与修复流程。
zh.hot: 本月新增 10765 star、总量 12844，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 TypeScript 第 8 名，核心吸引力在于用网页版额度跑 Codex 任务、省下 Codex 配额。
uses: 已有 ChatGPT 订阅（含 Pro）但 Codex 额度紧张的开发者
希望在 Codex 工作流里直接使用网页版模型与图片、流式输出的用户
需要让 ChatGPT 访问本地文件、终端和工具链的 MCP 玩家
想省下 Codex/Work 配额、把网页版额度用于编码任务的重度用户

en.tag: Use ChatGPT Web (incl. Pro) as a native model in Codex, without burning Codex quota
en.what: A bridge that lets Codex call ChatGPT Web models, including Pro, using ChatGPT Web's separate usage limits instead of your Work or Codex quota. It keeps Codex's native interface, tasks, images and streaming, and its Full harness mode wires ChatGPT to the current task's files, terminal, tools and approvals via MCP.
en.content: It ships launcher installers for Windows, macOS and Linux (exe/dmg/AppImage) with a bundled browser and runtime, so no separate Chrome, Node or Bun install is needed, plus architecture docs, a troubleshooting guide and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript, integrated with Codex through MCP, with an embedded browser runtime for signing in to ChatGPT Web; also offers terminal-based install, update and repair flows.
en.hot: It gained 10,765 stars this month for a total of 12,844, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending's monthly TypeScript list, mainly because it lets you run Codex tasks on web-plan quota and save Codex credits.
uses: Developers with a ChatGPT plan (including Pro) who are short on Codex quota
Users who want web models with images and streaming inside the Codex workflow
MCP tinkerers who need ChatGPT to reach local files, terminal and tools
Heavy users who want to save Codex/Work credits by spending web-plan quota on coding

zh.tag: 面向 AI 代理的一体化 Office 运行时 SDK
zh.what: Univer 是一个开源 Office SDK，让开发者把电子表格、文档、演示、看板、关系表与 PDF 等办公能力嵌入到自己的产品中。它定位为「AI 代理的 Office 载体」，为智能体提供可编程的办公文档运行时。
zh.content: 仓库以 TypeScript 包形式组织，包含核心引擎、插件模块、公式引擎、Canvas 渲染层与统一 Facade API，并配有 docs 文档、示例与多语言 README。
zh.stack: 主语言 TypeScript，基于 Canvas 渲染与插件化架构，提供浏览器与 Node.js 通用的 Facade API，依赖 pnpm 工作区与 CI/CD 工具链。
zh.hot: 今日新增 1082 star、总数 17654，冲上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 3，AI 代理与办公自动化结合是当前热点，Univer 正好卡住这一需求。
uses: AI 代理开发者：为智能体提供可读写电子表格与文档的运行时
SaaS 产品团队：在自有应用中嵌入表格、文档与演示编辑能力
低代码/协作平台：基于插件架构定制办公组件
研究者与学习者：研究 Canvas 渲染、公式引擎与 Office 文档模型

en.tag: The Office Harness for AI Agents — one runtime for docs, sheets, slides
en.what: Univer is an open-source Office SDK that lets developers embed spreadsheet, document, presentation, board, relational-table and PDF experiences directly into their own products. Positioned as the Office Harness for AI Agents, it gives agents a programmable runtime for office documents.
en.content: The repo is organized as TypeScript packages: a core engine, plugin modules, a formula engine, a Canvas rendering layer and a unified Facade API, plus docs, examples and multilingual READMEs.
en.stack: Written mainly in TypeScript with Canvas-based rendering and a plugin architecture, exposing one Facade API for both browser and Node.js, managed via pnpm workspaces and CI/CD tooling.
en.hot: With 1,082 stars added today and 17,654 total, it hit #3 on GitHub Trending daily — riding the hot intersection of AI agents and office automation.
uses: AI agent developers: give agents a runtime to read and write spreadsheets and docs
SaaS product teams: embed spreadsheet, document and presentation editing in their apps
Low-code/collaboration platforms: customize office components via the plugin architecture
Researchers and learners: study Canvas rendering, formula engines and office document models

zh.tag: 开源免费的实时行情追踪与公司洞察平台
zh.what: OpenStock 是昂贵金融行情平台的开源替代品，支持追踪实时股价、设置个性化提醒，并查看详细的公司信息。项目由 Open Dev Society 公开构建，承诺永久免费，面向所有投资者开放。
zh.content: 仓库为 TypeScript 前端项目，包含仪表盘等界面资源（如 public/assets/images/dashboard.png），并配有 Star History、Trendshift 等徽章展示热度。整体以 Web 应用形态呈现，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.stack: 主语言为 TypeScript，属于前端/全栈 Web 应用，依赖现代 JS 生态构建界面与数据展示。采用 AGPL-3.0 许可，修改或部署为服务需开源并署名。
zh.hot: 已获约 16,050 颗星，今日新增 472 星，位列 GitHub Trending 日榜第 6。免费替代付费行情平台的定位切中痛点，加上开源社区运营，推动其快速走红。
uses: 个人投资者：免费追踪实时股价并设置价格提醒
开发者：基于 TypeScript 二次开发或自建行情看板
开源爱好者：参与 Open Dev Society 的公开协作项目
预算有限的小团队：替代昂贵的商业行情平台

en.tag: A free, open-source alternative to pricey market data platforms
en.what: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms, letting users track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights. Built openly by Open Dev Society, it is promised to stay free forever for everyone.
en.content: The repo is a TypeScript web app containing UI assets such as the dashboard screenshot in public/assets/images, plus Star History and Trendshift badges. It ships as a web application under the AGPL-3.0 license.
en.stack: Primarily TypeScript, it is a front-end/full-stack web app built on the modern JS ecosystem for UI and data display. Licensed AGPL-3.0, requiring source release and attribution if modified or deployed as a service.
en.hot: It has around 16,050 stars with 472 added today, ranking #6 on GitHub Trending daily. Its pitch as a free replacement for paid market platforms hits a real pain point, and open community building fuels the surge.
uses: Individual investors: track real-time prices and set alerts for free
Developers: fork or extend the TypeScript codebase for custom dashboards
Open-source enthusiasts: contribute to Open Dev Society's public project
Budget-limited small teams: replace costly commercial market platforms

zh.tag: 开源企业级业务管理平台，集 ERP、CRM、HRM、ATS 与项目管理于一体
zh.what: Ever Gauzy 是一个面向协作、按需和共享经济的开源业务管理平台，提供企业资源规划（ERP）、客户关系管理（CRM）、人力资源管理（HRM）、招聘跟踪（ATS）以及工作与项目管理（PM）等核心功能。它旨在帮助企业在一个统一的系统中管理财务、销售、库存、员工和项目等关键业务流程。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的平台源代码，主要使用 TypeScript 编写，提供无头 API、仪表盘、时间跟踪、员工管理、招聘、销售管道、会计发票等模块。还包括详细的文档和部署指南，支持 Gitpod 在线开发。
zh.stack: 技术栈以 TypeScript 为主，基于 Node.js 和 NestJS 构建后端，前端可能使用 Angular 或 React，数据库支持 PostgreSQL、MySQL 等，并采用 AGPL v3 许可证。
zh.hot: 该项目今日新增 191 颗星，登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 2 名，总星数达 5084，表明其作为开源 ERP/CRM 替代方案正受到广泛关注。
uses: 中小企业寻求开源 ERP/CRM 解决方案以降低软件成本
开发团队需要可定制、可扩展的业务管理平台进行二次开发
人力资源和招聘团队希望集成 ATS 和员工管理功能
项目管理和咨询公司需要时间跟踪与项目协作工具

en.tag: Open business management platform combining ERP, CRM, HRM, ATS and project management
en.what: Ever Gauzy is an open business management platform for collaborative, on-demand and sharing economies, offering Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), Customer Relationship Management (CRM), Human Resource Management (HRM), Applicant Tracking System (ATS), and Work and Project Management (PM). It aims to help businesses manage key processes like finance, sales, inventory, employees, and projects in one unified system.
en.content: The repository contains the full platform source code, primarily written in TypeScript, offering headless APIs, dashboards, time tracking, employee management, ATS, sales pipelines, accounting/invoicing modules, and more. It also includes detailed documentation and deployment guides, with Gitpod support for online development.
en.stack: The tech stack is primarily TypeScript, with a Node.js and NestJS backend, possibly Angular or React frontend, and support for databases like PostgreSQL and MySQL, under the AGPL v3 license.
en.hot: The project gained 191 stars today, ranking 2nd on GitHub Trending daily list, with a total of 5,084 stars, indicating growing attention as an open-source ERP/CRM alternative.
uses: Small and medium businesses seeking open-source ERP/CRM solutions to reduce software costs
Development teams needing a customizable and extensible business management platform for secondary development
HR and recruitment teams looking to integrate ATS and employee management features
Project management and consulting firms requiring time tracking and project collaboration tools

zh.tag: 开源自托管 AI 销售 CRM，原生 AI 代理接管 WhatsApp 聊天
zh.what: DeskcommCRM 是一个开源的 AI 销售操作系统，把能接待、筛选并促成成交的 AI 代理直接嵌进 CRM，通过 WhatsApp（WAHA）与客户对话。它是 Kommo、Octadesk、Intercom 的开源替代品，数据自持、无月费、无功能锁。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Next.js 应用主体、WAHA 的 WhatsApp 集成、Supabase 数据库与认证、多租户与 LGPD 合规逻辑，以及 hostgator-setup-kit 一键部署脚本和架构/路线图文档。
zh.stack: 技术栈为 TypeScript（strict）+ Next.js 16，后端依赖 Supabase（Postgres、Auth、Storage），WhatsApp 通道使用 WAHA，支持 MCP、多租户与自托管部署。
zh.hot: 上线不久即冲到 GitHub Trending 日榜第 4，今日新增 152 star、总数 1347，说明拉美市场对「开源 + WhatsApp 原生 AI 销售」的需求被长期压抑。
uses: 通过 WhatsApp 成交的中小企业与销售团队，想摆脱 Kommo/Octadesk 的月费与功能锁定
需要数据主权与 LGPD 合规、希望把 CRM 跑在自己 VPS 上的巴西及拉美公司
想给现有销售流程加 AI 代理、并接入 MCP 生态的开发者与集成商
寻找 Intercom 开源替代、重视自托管与多租户能力的 SaaS 团队

en.tag: Open-source self-hosted AI sales CRM with native AI agents on WhatsApp
en.what: DeskcommCRM is an open-source AI sales OS that embeds AI agents capable of greeting, qualifying and closing deals directly inside a CRM, conversing with customers over WhatsApp (WAHA). It positions itself as the open alternative to Kommo, Octadesk and Intercom, with self-owned data, no monthly fees and no locked features.
en.content: The repo contains the Next.js app, WhatsApp integration via WAHA, Supabase database and auth, multi-tenant and LGPD compliance logic, plus a hostgator-setup-kit one-command deploy script and architecture/roadmap docs.
en.stack: Built with strict TypeScript and Next.js 16, backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage), using WAHA for the WhatsApp channel, with MCP support, multi-tenancy and self-hosted deployment.
en.hot: It hit #4 on GitHub Trending with 152 stars added today and 1,347 total, showing pent-up demand in LATAM for an open-source, WhatsApp-native AI sales tool.

Brazilian and LATAM companies needing data sovereignty and LGPD compliance by running the CRM on their own VPS
Developers and integrators adding AI agents to existing sales flows and plugging into the MCP ecosystem
SaaS teams seeking an open-source Intercom alternative with self-hosting and multi-tenancy

zh.tag: 模块化物流与供应链操作系统
zh.what: Fleetbase 是一个模块化的物流与供应链操作系统，覆盖运输管理、调度派单、路径优化与实时追踪等环节。它面向电商、餐饮、快递、现场服务等需要自建物流能力的组织，提供可扩展的开源平台。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心后端服务、控制台界面与模块化扩展体系，配套完整的 API 文档、云版本入口和 Discord 社区，整体以可插拔模块组织物流功能。
zh.stack: 以 JavaScript 为主，采用模块化架构，提供 REST API 与可扩展的插件机制，依赖现代 Node.js 生态与前端控制台框架。
zh.hot: 今日新增 530 star，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 日榜第 6 名，说明开发者对可自托管的开源物流系统需求旺盛。
uses: 电商与零售团队：管理配送、追踪订单并优化最后一公里物流
餐饮与快递企业：调度司机、规划路线并提供客户实时追踪
现场服务与运维团队：安排技师、管理服务区域并跟踪工单完成
开发者与企业：基于模块化架构和完整 API 构建定制供应链方案

en.tag: Modular logistics and supply chain operating system
en.what: Fleetbase is a modular logistics and supply chain operating system covering transportation management, dispatching, route optimization, and real-time tracking. It targets e-commerce, food and beverage, courier, and field service organizations that need to build their own logistics capabilities on an extensible open-source platform.
en.content: The repo contains the core backend services, a console UI, and a modular extension system, along with full API docs, a cloud version entry point, and a Discord community, organizing logistics features as pluggable modules.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript with a modular architecture, exposing REST APIs and an extensible plugin mechanism, built on the modern Node.js ecosystem and a frontend console framework.
en.hot: It gained 530 stars today and ranked 6th on the GitHub Trending JavaScript daily list, showing strong developer demand for self-hostable open-source logistics systems.
uses: E-commerce and retail teams: manage deliveries, track orders, and optimize last-mile logistics
Food, beverage, and courier businesses: dispatch drivers, plan routes, and offer real-time customer tracking
Field service and operations teams: schedule technicians, manage service areas, and track job completion
Developers and enterprises: build custom supply chain solutions with a modular architecture and full API access

zh.tag: 小说家打造的无干扰写作软件，专注写书本身
zh.what: NEO 是一款专为写小说设计的本地写作软件，从安装起就假定你只写书，界面像书稿而非文档列表。它完全离线运行，稿件以纯文本文件保存在本地，无需账号、订阅，且免费。
zh.content: 仓库包含 macOS（.dmg/arm64）、Windows（安装版与便携版 .exe）和 Linux（.AppImage）的安装包与发布文件，以及应用源码。核心功能有书架式书库、自动章节编号、Darlings 暂存区、占位符待办和进度条。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，基于 Electron 构建跨平台桌面应用，本地文件存储，无后端服务或云依赖。
zh.hot: 本周新增 222 星、总计 1340 星，登上 GitHub Trending JavaScript 周榜第 7 名；由小说家亲自打造、免费无订阅的定位，加上对写作者痛点的精准回应，吸引了大量关注。
uses: 小说与长篇虚构写作者，需要沉浸式无干扰环境
厌倦订阅制与云同步、重视本地纯文本存稿的作者
想用书架式管理多部作品、系列与笔名的写手
对 Electron 桌面应用或写作工具设计感兴趣的开发者

en.tag: A distraction-free word processor for novelists, built by a novelist
en.what: NEO is a local writing app built specifically for novelists, assuming from install that you only write books, with manuscripts that look like books. It runs fully offline, saves drafts as plain files on your disk, and needs no accounts, subscriptions, or fees.
en.content: The repo holds installers and release files for macOS (.dmg/arm64), Windows (setup and portable .exe), and Linux (.AppImage), plus the app source. Core features include a bookshelf-style library, auto-numbered chapters, a Darlings holding area, placeholder to-dos, and progress bars.
en.stack: Written mainly in JavaScript and built as a cross-platform desktop app with Electron, using local file storage with no backend or cloud dependency.
en.hot: It gained 222 stars this week for a total of 1,340, ranking 7th on GitHub Trending's weekly JavaScript chart. Being built by a novelist, free with no subscription, and sharply tuned to writers' pain points has drawn wide attention.
uses: Novelists and long-form fiction writers who need a distraction-free environment
Authors tired of subscriptions and cloud sync who value local plain-text drafts
Writers managing multiple books, series, or pen names with a bookshelf view
Developers curious about Electron desktop apps or writing-tool design

zh.tag: 跨平台浏览器引擎，驱动 Safari 等应用
zh.what: WebKit 是一个跨平台网页浏览器引擎，在 iOS 和 macOS 上驱动 Safari、邮件、Apple Books 等应用，也支持 Linux。它负责渲染网页内容，是许多苹果生态应用的核心组件。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 WebKit 引擎源代码，包括渲染引擎、JavaScript 引擎、网络层等，以及构建脚本、测试套件和开发工具。
zh.stack: 主要使用 C++、JavaScript 和 Objective-C 等语言，依赖 Xcode 构建工具链，支持 macOS、iOS、Linux 等平台。
zh.hot: 作为 Safari 和众多苹果应用的核心引擎，WebKit 一直是开发者关注的焦点。本月新增 149 stars，总 stars 达 10214，在 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 分类中排名第 18。
uses: 浏览器引擎开发者 —— 需要深入了解或贡献 WebKit 的开发者
苹果平台应用开发者 —— 希望优化应用内网页渲染性能的开发者
Web 标准爱好者 —— 关注浏览器引擎实现和 Web 标准进展的技术人员

en.tag: Cross-platform browser engine powering Safari and more
en.what: WebKit is a cross-platform web browser engine that powers Safari, Mail, Apple Books, and many other applications on iOS and macOS, with support for Linux. It handles web content rendering and is a core component of many Apple ecosystem apps.
en.content: The repository contains the complete WebKit engine source code, including rendering engine, JavaScript engine, networking layer, as well as build scripts, test suites, and development tools.
en.stack: Primarily written in C++, JavaScript, and Objective-C, it relies on the Xcode toolchain for building and supports platforms like macOS, iOS, and Linux.
en.hot: As the core engine behind Safari and many Apple apps, WebKit remains a focus for developers. It gained 149 stars this month, reaching 10,214 total stars, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending monthly JavaScript list.
uses: Browser engine developers — those who want to understand or contribute to WebKit
Apple platform app developers — those looking to optimize web rendering performance in their apps
Web standards enthusiasts — technologists interested in browser engine implementations and web standards progress

zh.tag: 免费无广告追剧资源指南，人工精选每日检测
zh.what: 这是一个聚合免费无广告追剧资源的导航型仓库，收录在线影视站、影视 APP、网盘搜索、磁力 BT、字幕、TVBox/影视仓接口、IPTV 直播源、会员拼团和影视开源项目。所有资源由人工精选，并通过自动化流程每天检测有效性。

zh.hot: 免费追剧是长期刚需，而它用“人工精选 + 每日自动检测”解决了资源失效快的痛点；本月新增 3452 star，总 star 达 11441，冲上 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 第 15 名。
uses: 想免费无广告追剧、找在线影视站和影视 APP 的普通用户
折腾 TVBox / 影视仓、需要接口配置和 IPTV 直播源的玩家
想找磁力 BT、字幕、网盘搜索等资源渠道的用户
关注影视类开源项目、想参与社区共建的开发者

en.tag: A free, ad-free guide to streaming resources, hand-picked and checked daily
en.what: This is a curated navigation repo for free, ad-free streaming resources, covering online movie sites, streaming apps, cloud-drive search, magnet/BT, subtitles, TVBox configs, IPTV sources, membership group-buys, and related open-source projects. Resources are hand-picked and automatically checked for availability every day.

en.stack: Primarily JavaScript, with resources maintained as JSON data and GitHub Actions handling availability checks (check-availability.yml) and data validation (validate-data.yml).

uses: Everyday users who want free, ad-free streaming sites and apps
Tinkerers setting up TVBox/Yingshicang who need config endpoints and IPTV sources
Users looking for magnet/BT, subtitle, and cloud-drive search channels
Developers interested in streaming-related open-source projects and community contributions

zh.tag: Vercel 官方 AI 编码代理技能合集
zh.what: 这是 Vercel 官方推出的 AI 编码代理技能集合，把指令和脚本打包成可复用的技能，用来扩展代理的能力。技能遵循 Agent Skills 格式，覆盖 Vercel 项目优化、React/Next.js 最佳实践、Web 设计规范与写作规范等场景。
zh.content: 仓库以技能为单位组织，目前包含 vercel-optimize、react-best-practices、web-design-guidelines、writing-guidelines 等技能，每个技能由说明文档和配套脚本组成，并附有 skills.sh 徽章。
zh.stack: 主语言为 JavaScript，围绕 Agent Skills 格式构建，技能内容以 Markdown 指令和脚本为主，主要面向 Vercel、React 与 Next.js 生态。
zh.hot: 作为 Vercel 官方出品，它把大厂工程经验直接封装成代理可用的技能，加上 3.2 万 star 和本月 1201 新增，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 第 16 名，热度很高。
uses: 使用 AI 编码代理并希望扩展其能力的开发者
需要优化 Vercel 项目成本与性能的团队
编写 React/Next.js 代码并关注性能最佳实践的工程师
想用代理自动审查 UI、无障碍与文档写作规范的团队

en.tag: Vercel's official collection of agent skills for AI coding agents
en.what: This is Vercel's official collection of skills for AI coding agents, packaging instructions and scripts into reusable capabilities that extend what agents can do. The skills follow the Agent Skills format and cover areas like Vercel project optimization, React/Next.js best practices, web design guidelines, and writing guidelines.
en.content: The repo is organized by skill, currently including vercel-optimize, react-best-practices, web-design-guidelines, and writing-guidelines. Each skill consists of documentation and supporting scripts, with a skills.sh badge included.
en.stack: The primary language is JavaScript, built around the Agent Skills format. Skill content is mainly Markdown instructions and scripts, targeting the Vercel, React, and Next.js ecosystem.
en.hot: As an official Vercel release, it packages big-company engineering know-how directly into agent-ready skills. With 32k stars and 1,201 added this month, it ranks 16th on GitHub Trending's monthly JavaScript list, showing strong momentum.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents who want to extend their capabilities
Teams needing to optimize Vercel project cost and performance
Engineers writing React/Next.js code with a focus on performance best practices
Teams wanting agents to auto-review UI, accessibility, and documentation writing standards

zh.tag: Claude Code 全家桶：代理、技能、钩子、规则与 MCP 配置
zh.what: 这是一个由 Anthropic 黑客松获奖者开发的 Claude Code 配置集合，包含生产级的代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置。这些配置经过 10 多个月的日常使用打磨，用于构建真实产品。
zh.content: 仓库包含代理、技能、钩子、命令、规则和 MCP 配置等目录，以及配套的速查指南和长文指南，涵盖令牌优化、记忆持久化、持续学习、验证循环、并行化等主题。
zh.stack: 主要使用 JavaScript/Node.js 编写，支持 TypeScript、Shell 和 Markdown。跨平台支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux，自动检测包管理器（npm、pnpm、yarn、bun）。
zh.hot: 本周新增 154 颗星，总星数突破 1000，登上 JavaScript 周榜第 9 名。作为黑客松获奖者的实战配置，吸引了大量 Claude Code 用户寻求高效开发工作流。
uses: Claude Code 用户：希望优化令牌使用、提升开发效率的开发者。
AI 辅助开发团队：需要标准化代理、技能和钩子配置的团队。
学习 AI 编程实践：想了解如何构建高效 AI 开发工作流的学习者。

en.tag: Complete Claude Code toolkit: agents, skills, hooks, rules, and MCP configs
en.what: A collection of Claude Code configurations from an Anthropic hackathon winner, including production-ready agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs. Evolved over 10+ months of intensive daily use building real products.
en.content: Includes directories for agents, skills, hooks, commands, rules, and MCP configs, along with shorthand and longform guides covering token optimization, memory persistence, continuous learning, verification loops, and parallelization.
en.stack: Primarily JavaScript/Node.js, with TypeScript, Shell, and Markdown. Cross-platform support for Windows, macOS, and Linux, with automatic package manager detection (npm, pnpm, yarn, bun).
en.hot: Gained 154 stars this week, surpassing 1000 total, ranking #9 on the JavaScript weekly trending. As a hackathon winner's real-world config, it attracts many Claude Code users seeking efficient dev workflows.
uses: Claude Code users: developers looking to optimize token usage and boost productivity.
AI-assisted dev teams: teams needing standardized agents, skills, and hooks.
Learners of AI coding practices: those wanting to build efficient AI dev workflows.

zh.tag: 突破 Telegram 下载限制的油猴脚本
zh.what: 这是一个用户脚本，允许你在 Telegram 网页版中下载图片、视频、GIF 和音频，即使群组或频道禁止下载。它通过注入代码解锁下载按钮，支持聊天、故事和私密频道。
zh.content: 仓库主要包含一个 JavaScript 用户脚本文件，以及安装说明和许可证。脚本通过 Greasy Fork 分发，支持多种浏览器和用户脚本管理器。
zh.stack: 基于 JavaScript 编写，依赖用户脚本管理器（如 Tampermonkey、Violentmonkey）运行在浏览器中。无后端依赖，纯前端实现。
zh.hot: Telegram 下载限制是常见痛点，该脚本提供了简单有效的解决方案，因此广受欢迎。目前获得 6001 颗星，本周新增 263 星，位列 GitHub Trending JavaScript 周榜第 6 名。
uses: 需要从 Telegram 受限群组或频道保存媒体文件的普通用户
研究人员或记者需要存档 Telegram 上的公开信息
经常使用 Telegram 网页版并希望增强下载功能的用户

en.tag: A userscript to bypass Telegram download restrictions
en.what: This is a userscript that enables downloading images, videos, GIFs, and audios from Telegram web apps, even in chats, stories, and private channels where downloading is restricted. It unlocks download buttons by injecting code into the web page.
en.content: The repository mainly contains a JavaScript userscript file, along with installation instructions and a license. The script is distributed via Greasy Fork and supports multiple browsers and userscript managers.
en.stack: Written in JavaScript, it relies on userscript managers (e.g., Tampermonkey, Violentmonkey) to run in the browser. It has no backend dependencies and is purely front-end.
en.hot: Telegram download restrictions are a common pain point, and this script provides a simple and effective solution, making it widely popular. It has 6,001 stars, with 263 added this week, ranking 6th on GitHub Trending JavaScript weekly.
uses: Regular users who need to save media from restricted Telegram groups or channels
Researchers or journalists who need to archive public information from Telegram
Users who frequently use Telegram web and want enhanced download capabilities

zh.tag: 抖音与 TikTok 作品下载及数据采集工具
zh.what: 这是一个用于下载抖音和 TikTok 平台视频、图集、实况动图等作品的工具，同时支持采集账号发布、喜欢、收藏等数据。项目原名 TikTokDownloader，现已更名为 DouK-Downloader。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心下载与采集逻辑、命令行交互界面、Docker 部署配置以及详细的中英文文档和 Wiki。
zh.stack: 项目主要使用 Python（≥3.12）开发，虽然 GitHub 标注主语言为 JavaScript，但实际核心为 Python，并支持 Docker 部署。
zh.hot: 凭借对抖音/TikTok 内容下载与数据采集的实用功能，该项目已获得 16620 颗星，本月新增 916 星，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 JavaScript 分类第 18 名。
uses: 需要批量下载抖音或 TikTok 视频、图集的内容创作者与运营人员
进行社交媒体数据分析的研究人员或营销团队
希望备份个人账号作品或收藏内容的普通用户
需要自动化采集公开作品数据的开发者

en.tag: Downloader and data scraper for Douyin and TikTok content
en.what: This is a tool for downloading videos, image galleries, and live photos from Douyin and TikTok, while also supporting data collection of account posts, likes, and favorites. Originally named TikTokDownloader, it has been renamed DouK-Downloader.
en.content: The repository contains core download and scraping logic, a command-line interface, Docker deployment configuration, and detailed documentation in both Chinese and English along with a Wiki.
en.stack: The project is primarily developed in Python (≥3.12), though GitHub lists JavaScript as the main language; it supports Docker deployment.
en.hot: With its practical features for downloading and scraping Douyin/TikTok content, the project has earned 16,620 stars, gaining 916 this month, ranking 18th on GitHub Trending monthly JavaScript list.
uses: Content creators and operators who need to batch download Douyin or TikTok videos and galleries
Researchers or marketing teams conducting social media data analysis
Regular users who want to back up their own account posts or favorites
Developers needing to automate collection of public content data

zh.tag: Rust 编写的高性能 S3 兼容分布式对象存储，4KB 小对象比 MinIO 快 2.3 倍
zh.what: RustFS 是一个用 Rust 构建的高性能分布式对象存储系统，兼容 S3 API，可与其他 S3 兼容平台（如 MinIO、Ceph）迁移和共存。它面向数据湖、AI 和大数据工作负载优化，采用 Apache 2.0 许可，规避 AGPL 限制。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、CI/Docker 工作流、多语言 README 和文档链接，提供安装指南、Discord 社区与问题追踪。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，依赖 S3 API 兼容层、分布式存储组件，支持 Docker 部署和 CI/CD 流程。
zh.hot: 凭借 2.3 倍于 MinIO 的 4KB 小对象性能、Rust 内存安全与 Apache 2.0 许可，RustFS 获得 32146 颗星，今日新增 79 星，登上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 21 名。
uses: 需要高性能 S3 兼容对象存储的云原生与大数据团队
从 MinIO 或 Ceph 迁移、寻求更优性能与许可的运维人员
构建 AI 数据湖、需要低延迟小对象读写的开发者

en.tag: A high-performance, S3-compatible distributed object storage system in Rust, 2.3x faster than MinIO for 4KB objects
en.what: RustFS is a high-performance distributed object storage system built in Rust, S3-compatible, and designed for migration and coexistence with other S3 platforms like MinIO and Ceph. It is optimized for data lakes, AI, and big data workloads, and released under Apache 2.0 to avoid AGPL restrictions.
en.content: The repo contains Rust source code, CI/Docker workflows, multilingual READMEs, and documentation links, with installation guides, Discord community, and issue tracking.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with S3 API compatibility, distributed storage components, Docker deployment, and CI/CD pipelines.
en.hot: With 2.3x faster 4KB object performance than MinIO, Rust memory safety, and Apache 2.0 licensing, RustFS has earned 32,146 stars, +79 today, ranking #21 on GitHub Trending (Rust).
uses: Cloud-native and big data teams needing high-performance S3-compatible object storage
Ops teams migrating from MinIO or Ceph seeking better performance and licensing
Developers building AI data lakes with low-latency small-object I/O

zh.tag: Cloudflare 出品的 Rust QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现
zh.what: quiche 是 Cloudflare 用 Rust 编写的 QUIC 传输协议与 HTTP/3 实现，遵循 IETF 规范。它提供处理 QUIC 数据包和连接状态的底层 API，由应用层自行负责 I/O、事件循环与定时器。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心 quiche 库、提供命令行客户端与服务端的 quiche-apps crate，以及示例证书和构建脚本。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写，发布在 crates.io 上，依赖 Rust 生态的加密与网络库，并提供 C 语言绑定。
zh.hot: 作为 Cloudflare 边缘网络 HTTP/3 的底层引擎，并被 Android DNS 解析器和 curl 采用，凭借 11847 颗星稳居 Rust 日榜第 8。
uses: 网络协议开发者，需要实现或研究 QUIC/HTTP/3 底层逻辑
希望为服务端或客户端添加 HTTP/3 支持的 Rust 工程师
想将 QUIC 集成进 curl、DNS 解析器等现有工具的项目维护者
关注高性能传输层与拥塞控制的研究与教学人员

en.tag: Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3
en.what: quiche is Cloudflare's Rust implementation of the QUIC transport protocol and HTTP/3 as specified by the IETF. It offers a low-level API for processing QUIC packets and managing connection state, leaving I/O, event loops and timers to the application.
en.content: The repo contains the core quiche library, a quiche-apps crate with command-line client and server, plus sample certificates and build scripts.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust and published on crates.io, it relies on Rust crypto and networking crates and also ships C bindings.
en.hot: As the engine behind Cloudflare's edge HTTP/3 and adopted by Android's DNS resolver and curl, it holds 11,847 stars and ranks 8th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Network protocol developers implementing or studying QUIC/HTTP/3 internals
Rust engineers adding HTTP/3 support to servers or clients
Maintainers integrating QUIC into tools like curl or DNS resolvers
Researchers and educators focused on high-performance transport and congestion control

zh.tag: 用 Rust 编写的开源远程桌面，可完全自托管替代 TeamViewer
zh.what: RustDesk 是一款开源的远程桌面控制软件，开箱即用、无需配置，用户可完全掌控自己的数据。它支持使用官方会合/中继服务器，也允许自建服务器或自行编写中继服务，作为 TeamViewer 的替代方案。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的客户端主体、res 资源与 logo、docs 下数十种语言的 README 翻译，以及构建说明（原生构建与 Docker 构建）和文件结构文档。
zh.stack: 以 Rust 为主语言，支持原生构建与 Docker 构建，配套独立的 rustdesk-server 会合/中继服务端项目。
zh.hot: 凭借 124797 颗星与本月新增 3143 星，稳居 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 5 名，反映出用户对自托管、隐私可控远程桌面方案的强烈需求。
uses: 需要自托管远程桌面、重视数据隐私的个人与团队
IT 运维人员远程管理内网或跨地域设备
希望替代 TeamViewer 等商业方案以降低成本的企业
想基于 Rust 二次开发或自建中继服务的开发者

en.tag: Open-source Rust remote desktop, self-hostable TeamViewer alternative
en.what: RustDesk is an open-source remote desktop application that works out of the box with no configuration required, giving users full control over their data. It can use the official rendezvous/relay servers, be self-hosted, or even have custom relay servers written, serving as an alternative to TeamViewer.
en.content: The repo contains the Rust client codebase, res assets and logos, README translations in dozens of languages under docs, plus build instructions (raw and Docker) and file-structure documentation.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust, with both raw and Docker build paths, paired with the separate rustdesk-server rendezvous/relay project.
en.hot: With 124,797 stars and 3,143 added this month, it ranks 5th on the GitHub Trending monthly Rust list, reflecting strong demand for self-hosted, privacy-controllable remote desktop solutions.
uses: Individuals and teams needing self-hosted remote desktop with data privacy
IT admins remotely managing intranet or cross-region devices
Businesses replacing commercial tools like TeamViewer to cut costs
Developers wanting to build on Rust or run custom relay servers

zh.tag: 为多种 AI 编码代理提供跨工具、跨项目的长期记忆与交接协议
zh.what: ai-memory 为 AI 编码 CLI 提供长期记忆层，让不同厂商的代理共享同一份项目知识。中途退出 Claude Code 后，可在同一目录用 Codex 继续任务，无需重新解释架构、失败尝试和未决问题。
zh.content: 核心是一个自托管的记忆服务器，记忆以 git 仓库中的普通 Markdown wiki 为真源，数据库只是可重建的派生索引；配套生命周期钩子、跨项目个人画像文档和二十多种代理的接入适配。
zh.stack: 使用 Rust 编写（要求 Rust 1.95+），MIT 许可，依赖自托管服务端、git 与 Markdown 文件存储，无向量数据库。
zh.hot: 本月新增 2958 星、总数约 9090，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 8 名；它切中了多代理切换时上下文丢失这一真实痛点，并以纯 Markdown、可自托管、团队共享的开放方案区别于各家封闭记忆功能。
uses: 同时使用 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 等多种编码代理的开发者，希望任务无缝交接
需要在多台机器或团队间共享项目记忆与未决问题的工程团队
偏好纯文本、可 grep、可版本控制记忆而非黑盒向量库的用户
希望自托管数据、重视隐私与审计日志的个人或组织

en.tag: Long-term memory and handoff protocol shared across multiple AI coding agents
en.what: ai-memory provides a long-term memory layer for AI coding CLIs, letting agents from different vendors share the same project knowledge. Quit Claude Code mid-task, open Codex in the same directory, and continue without re-explaining the architecture, failed approaches, or open questions.
en.content: At its core is a self-hosted memory server whose source of truth is a git-backed wiki of plain Markdown files, with the database as a rebuildable derived index; it ships lifecycle hooks, cross-project profile docs, and adapters for 20+ agent harnesses.
en.stack: Written in Rust (requires Rust 1.95+), MIT licensed, relying on a self-hosted server, git, and Markdown file storage with no vector database.
en.hot: It gained 2,958 stars this month for ~9,090 total, ranking 8th on GitHub Trending's monthly Rust list; it addresses the real pain of losing context when switching agents, standing out from closed vendor memory features with plain Markdown, self-hosting, and team sharing.
uses: Developers juggling Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and other agents who want seamless task handoff
Engineering teams needing to share project memory and open questions across machines or members
Users who prefer plain-text, greppable, version-controlled memory over black-box vector stores
Individuals or organizations wanting self-hosted data with privacy and audit logging

zh.tag: 把编码代理变成科研代理的本地优先工作台
zh.what: OpenResearch 是 alphaXiv 推出的本地优先科研代理工作台，让 AI 代理自动完成文献综述、提出假设、运行实验并产出研究产物。它把通用编码代理升级为可执行完整科研流程的助手，兼顾 copilot 与自动研究两种用法。
zh.content: 仓库提供跨平台桌面应用（macOS/Windows/Linux 安装包），包含代理对话界面、实验日志视图、多语言 README 与 docs 文档目录。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，构建本地优先的桌面应用，依赖各平台原生运行环境（macOS 11+、Windows 需 Git for Windows、Linux 需 glibc 2.35+）。
zh.hot: 发布不久即冲到 6809 star，本月新增 6349，几乎全部热度来自最近一个月，并登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 9 名。
uses: 科研人员与研究生：用代理自动做文献调研和实验记录
AI 工程师：把编码代理扩展为可执行科研流程的代理
独立研究者：在本地环境跑可复现的自动研究实验
技术团队：评估 agent 在真实科研工作流中的落地方式

en.tag: A local-first harness that turns coding agents into research agents
en.what: OpenResearch is a local-first harness and workspace from alphaXiv that turns coding agents into research agents capable of reviewing literature, forming hypotheses, running experiments, and producing research artifacts. It works both as a copilot and as an autoresearch tool.
en.content: It ships a cross-platform desktop app (macOS/Windows/Linux installers) with an agent conversation UI, experiment log views, multilingual READMEs, and a docs folder.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust as a local-first desktop app, requiring macOS 11+, Git for Windows on Windows, and glibc 2.35+ on Linux.
en.hot: It has reached 6,809 stars with 6,349 added this month, meaning nearly all its traction is recent, landing it at #9 on GitHub's monthly Rust trending list.
uses: Researchers and grad students automating literature review and experiment logging
AI engineers extending coding agents into research-capable agents
Independent researchers running reproducible autoresearch experiments locally
Teams evaluating how agents perform in real research workflows

zh.tag: 基于 Tauri 的现代化跨平台代理客户端
zh.what: Clash Verge Rev 是 Clash Verge 的延续项目，一个基于 Tauri 的 Clash Meta GUI 客户端，为 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 提供定制化的代理体验。它内置 mihomo 内核，帮助用户便捷地管理和切换代理节点与规则。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的 Tauri 后端（src-tauri）与前端界面，提供安装包、多语言 README 文档、预览截图以及配置管理、节点编辑、WebDav 同步等功能模块。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 与 Tauri 2 框架，内置 Clash.Meta(mihomo) 内核，前端界面支持自定义主题与 CSS 注入。
zh.hot: 凭借 14.6 万 star 和今日新增 466 的热度，它因跨平台、界面美观且功能强大而深受代理用户青睐，稳居 Rust 日榜第 16 名。
uses: 需要跨平台代理客户端的普通用户，追求简洁美观的图形界面
希望可视化编辑节点与规则的高级玩家
需要 TUN 模式或系统代理守卫的开发者与运维人员
想通过 WebDav 同步配置的多设备用户

en.tag: A modern cross-platform proxy client built on Tauri
en.what: Clash Verge Rev is a continuation of Clash Verge, a Clash Meta GUI client built on Tauri that delivers a tailored proxy experience on Windows, macOS, and Linux. It bundles the mihomo core to help users easily manage and switch proxy nodes and rules.
en.content: The repo contains a Rust-based Tauri backend (src-tauri) and a frontend UI, offering installers, multilingual README docs, preview screenshots, and feature modules for config management, node editing, and WebDav sync.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust and the Tauri 2 framework, bundling the Clash.Meta (mihomo) core, with a frontend supporting custom themes and CSS injection.
en.hot: With 146k stars and 466 added today, it's favored by proxy users for being cross-platform, polished, and feature-rich, ranking 16th on the Rust daily trending list.
uses: Everyday users wanting a cross-platform proxy client with a clean GUI
Advanced users who need visual node and rule editing
Developers and ops staff needing TUN mode or system proxy guard
Multi-device users who want to sync configs via WebDav

zh.tag: 基于对象存储的 Rust 分布式图数据库
zh.what: HydraDB 是一个用 Rust 编写的对象存储原生分布式图数据库，将持久化图数据存放在 S3 兼容对象存储上，实现存储与计算完全分离。它支持快照一致的 OpenCypher 查询、GraphBLAS 遍历、Neo4j 兼容的 Bolt 连接以及 HTTPS 查询 API。
zh.content: 仓库包含数据节点（graph-node）与索引器（graph-indexer）两类计算角色、SlateDB 存储层、OpenCypher 查询引擎、GraphBLAS 遍历实现、Bolt/HTTP 接口，以及容器镜像、OpenCypher TCK 测试和在线基准测试配置。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 1.91+，依赖 SlateDB 做持久化、SuiteSparse GraphBLAS 做稀疏遍历，支持 S3 兼容对象存储、Neo4j Bolt 5.x 驱动与 HTTPS JSON/NDJSON API，采用 AGPL-3.0 许可。
zh.hot: 它以“对象存储上的图数据库”这一新颖架构切中云原生图计算痛点，今日新增 1344 star 冲上 GitHub Trending Rust 日榜第 1 名，总 star 达 5906，热度极高。
uses: 需要云原生、低成本图数据库的架构师与后端工程师
使用 Neo4j 生态、希望迁移到对象存储方案的团队
研究存储计算分离与分布式图查询的开发者
在 S3 上构建大规模知识图谱或关系网络的应用方

en.tag: A Rust distributed graph database built on object storage
en.what: HydraDB is an object-store-native distributed graph database written in Rust, keeping durable graph data on S3-compatible object storage with fully disaggregated storage and compute. It offers snapshot-consistent OpenCypher queries, GraphBLAS traversal, Neo4j-compatible Bolt connectivity, and an HTTPS query API.
en.content: The repo contains two compute roles (graph-node and graph-indexer), a SlateDB storage layer, an OpenCypher query engine, GraphBLAS traversal, Bolt/HTTP interfaces, plus container images, OpenCypher TCK tests, and live benchmark setup.
en.stack: Built in Rust 1.91+, it relies on SlateDB for durability and SuiteSparse GraphBLAS for sparse traversal, supports S3-compatible object storage, Neo4j Bolt 5.x drivers, and HTTPS JSON/NDJSON APIs, under AGPL-3.0.
en.hot: Its novel "graph database on object storage" architecture addresses cloud-native graph computing pain points, and with 1,344 stars added today it tops the GitHub Trending Rust daily chart, reaching 5,906 total stars.
uses: Architects and backend engineers needing a cloud-native, low-cost graph database
Teams using the Neo4j ecosystem looking to move to an object-storage approach
Developers researching disaggregated storage/compute and distributed graph queries
Applications building large knowledge graphs or relationship networks on S3

zh.tag: 面向编码代理的版本控制，多代理并行改动可追溯可查询
zh.what: Atlas 是给编码代理用的“源代码管理”工具。每次代理运行都会生成 checkpoint，把提交与产生它的会话、提示词、工具调用和推理过程绑定在一起，让你清楚看到哪个代理做了什么、为什么这么做。它还支持在同一代码库上并行运行多个代理，并共享记忆。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 编写的桌面应用源码（macOS/Windows）、图标与落地页素材、CI 与发布工作流，以及指向文档站、官网和 Discord 的入口。
zh.stack: 主语言为 Rust，提供 macOS 与 Windows 桌面客户端；集成 Claude Code、Codex、Atlas 自带代理以及 ACP 注册表中的代理，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。
zh.hot: 本周新增 2593 star、总数达 8428，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜 Rust 第 8 名；多代理协作与可追溯性正成为 AI 编码工作流的热点需求。
uses: 同时使用多个编码代理、需要统一追踪改动的开发者
希望回溯某次提交由哪个代理、哪条提示词产生的团队
在任务中途切换代理、又不想丢失上下文的工程师
研究 AI 代理协作与可观测性的技术团队

en.tag: Source control for coding agents: run multiple agents, track and query their changes in one place
en.what: Atlas is source control built for coding agents. Every agent run produces checkpoints that link a commit back to the session that made it, together with prompts, tool calls, and reasoning, so you can see which agent did what and why. It also lets you run multiple agents side by side against the same codebase with shared memory.
en.content: The repo holds the Rust desktop app source for macOS and Windows, icon and landing-page assets, CI and release workflows, plus links to the docs site, website, and Discord.
en.stack: Written primarily in Rust with desktop clients for macOS and Windows; integrates Claude Code, Codex, Atlas's own agent, and agents from the ACP registry, under Apache 2.0.
en.hot: It gained 2,593 stars this week for a total of 8,428, ranking 8th on the GitHub Trending weekly Rust chart, as multi-agent collaboration and traceability become hot needs in AI coding workflows.
uses: Developers running several coding agents who need unified change tracking
Teams wanting to trace which agent and prompt produced a given commit
Engineers switching agents mid-task without losing context
Teams researching AI agent collaboration and observability

zh.tag: Rust 开源 CAD，支持 2D/3D 与 DWG/DXF 原生读写
zh.what: Open CAD Studio 是一个用 Rust 构建的开源 CAD 应用，提供 2D 绘图和 3D 建模功能，支持桌面端和 Web 端。它能够原生读写 DWG 和 DXF 文件，无需转换服务，并利用 GPU 加速渲染。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 CAD 应用源码，涵盖桌面端和 Web 端，提供统一的编辑核心。项目包含多语言 README、资源文件（如 logo）、示例工作区截图，以及用于 Web 部署的站点目录。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言，并可能涉及 WebAssembly（用于 Web 端）、GPU 渲染库（如 wgpu）以及 DWG/DXF 解析库。具体依赖需查看 Cargo.toml。
zh.hot: 该项目在 GitHub 上迅速获得关注，今日新增 46 星，总星数达 1166，位列 Rust 趋势榜第 6。其亮点在于用 Rust 实现 CAD，提供原生 DWG/DXF 支持，填补了开源 CAD 领域的空白。
uses: 工程师和设计师需要免费、跨平台的 CAD 工具进行 2D 制图或 3D 建模。
开发者希望研究或扩展一个基于 Rust 的现代 CAD 应用，或贡献代码。
教育机构或学生需要学习 CAD 概念，并希望使用开源软件进行实践。
需要处理 DWG/DXF 文件但不想依赖商业软件或在线转换服务的用户。

en.tag: Open-source CAD in Rust: 2D/3D drawing, native DWG/DXF, GPU rendering
en.what: Open CAD Studio is an open-source CAD application built with Rust, offering 2D drafting and 3D modeling for desktop and web. It natively reads and writes DWG and DXF files without conversion services, with GPU-accelerated rendering.
en.content: The repository contains the full source code of the CAD app, covering desktop and web with a shared editing core. It includes multi-language READMEs, assets like logo, workspace screenshots, and a site directory for web deployment.
en.stack: Primarily built with Rust, likely using WebAssembly for the web version, GPU rendering libraries like wgpu, and DWG/DXF parsing crates. Specific dependencies are in Cargo.toml.
en.hot: The project is gaining traction on GitHub, with 46 stars today and 1166 total, ranking #6 on the Rust trending list. Its novelty lies in a Rust-based CAD with native DWG/DXF support, filling a gap in open-source CAD.
uses: Engineers and designers needing a free, cross-platform CAD tool for 2D drafting or 3D modeling.
Developers interested in studying or extending a modern Rust-based CAD application or contributing code.
Educational institutions or students learning CAD concepts with open-source software.
Users who need to handle DWG/DXF files without relying on commercial software or online conversion services.

zh.tag: 开源间隔重复记忆卡片软件，用算法帮你高效背东西
zh.what: Anki 是一款基于间隔重复算法的智能记忆卡片程序，通过科学安排复习时间帮助用户长期记住知识。它支持文字、图片、音频、视频等多种卡片形式，并提供跨平台同步。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Anki 桌面版的完整源代码，涵盖 Rust 核心逻辑、Python 后端、TypeScript/Svelte 前端界面，以及构建脚本、开发文档和贡献指南。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 编写核心算法，结合 Python 处理业务逻辑，前端采用 TypeScript 和 Svelte，构建系统基于 Bazel 和 Ninja。
zh.hot: Anki 是间隔重复领域的标杆项目，拥有超过 3 万 star，今日新增 58 star 并登上 GitHub Trending 日榜第 9 名，反映出持续高涨的学习工具需求。
uses: 学生和语言学习者，用于记忆单词、概念和考试知识点
专业人士备考各类认证考试，如医学、法律、工程等
教育工作者制作和分享教学卡片组
开发者研究间隔重复算法和跨平台桌面应用架构

en.tag: Open-source spaced repetition flashcard program for efficient memorization
en.what: Anki is a smart flashcard program based on spaced repetition algorithms, scheduling reviews to help users retain knowledge long-term. It supports text, images, audio, and video cards with cross-platform sync.
en.content: The repo contains the full source code for Anki's desktop version, including Rust core logic, Python backend, TypeScript/Svelte frontend, build scripts, dev docs, and contribution guidelines.
en.stack: Primarily written in Rust for core algorithms, with Python for business logic, TypeScript and Svelte for the frontend, and a build system based on Bazel and Ninja.
en.hot: Anki is a benchmark project in spaced repetition with over 30k stars, gaining 58 stars today and ranking 9th on GitHub Trending daily, reflecting sustained demand for learning tools.
uses: Students and language learners memorizing vocabulary, concepts, and exam points
Professionals preparing for certification exams in medicine, law, engineering, etc.
Educators creating and sharing teaching card decks
Developers studying spaced repetition algorithms and cross-platform desktop app architecture

zh.tag: 全球首个开源企业世界模型，用 Rust 构建知识工程底座
zh.what: Utopia 是 DeepLethe 打造的企业世界模型，旨在成为知识工程的开源基座。它能够被动学习并自我治理，超越传统知识图谱与向量数据库的局限。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Rust 源码、Docker 容器配置、多语言 README（含中文）以及路线图等文档。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Rust 语言开发，提供 Docker 容器镜像，采用 Apache 2.0 许可证。
zh.hot: 本月新增 7716 星，总星数达 8153，登上 GitHub Trending 月榜 Rust 第 12 名，反映出社区对企业级开源世界模型的高度关注。
uses: 企业知识工程师：构建和维护企业级知识图谱与语义层
AI 应用开发者：为智能代理提供可自我治理的世界模型后端
数据平台架构师：评估开源知识工程基础设施的选型
Rust 技术爱好者：研究大型 Rust 项目架构与实现

en.tag: World's first open-source enterprise world model, a Rust-built knowledge engineering substrate
en.what: Utopia is an enterprise world model built by DeepLethe, designed as an open substrate for knowledge engineering. It learns passively and governs itself, going beyond traditional knowledge graphs and vector databases.
en.content: The repository contains Rust source code, Docker container configuration, multilingual READMEs (including Chinese), and documentation such as a roadmap.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Rust, with Docker container images available, under the Apache 2.0 license.
en.hot: Gained 7,716 stars this month, reaching 8,153 total, and ranked 12th on GitHub Trending monthly for Rust, reflecting strong community interest in open-source enterprise world models.
uses: Enterprise knowledge engineers: building and maintaining enterprise knowledge graphs and semantic layers
AI application developers: providing a self-governing world model backend for intelligent agents
Data platform architects: evaluating open-source knowledge engineering infrastructure
Rust enthusiasts: studying the architecture and implementation of large Rust projects

zh.tag: 一键切换 Antigravity 账号的桌面管理工具
zh.what: Antigravity Tools 是一款专为开发者和 AI 爱好者设计的桌面应用，用于管理 Antigravity 账号并实现一键无缝切换。它还能将 Web 端 Session 转化为标准 API，充当本地 AI 中转站。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Tauri v2 + React 前端和 Rust 后端，提供图形界面进行账号管理、协议转换和请求调度。
zh.stack: 基于 Tauri v2、React 和 Rust，使用现代桌面应用框架，支持跨平台。
zh.hot: 凭借 3 万+ Star 和日增 84 的热度，它解决了 AI 账号管理的痛点，提供高效便捷的本地中转方案。
uses: 需要管理多个 Antigravity 账号的开发者，可一键切换，提升效率。
希望将 Web Session 转为 API 的 AI 爱好者，用于本地集成和调用。
追求低成本、高稳定 AI 中转服务的用户，可结合赞助商服务使用。

en.tag: One-click Antigravity account manager & switcher desktop app
en.what: Antigravity Tools is a desktop app for developers and AI enthusiasts to manage Antigravity accounts and switch between them seamlessly with one click. It also converts web sessions into standard APIs, acting as a local AI relay.
en.content: The repo contains a Tauri v2 + React frontend and Rust backend, offering a GUI for account management, protocol conversion, and request routing.
en.stack: Built with Tauri v2, React, and Rust, leveraging a modern desktop framework for cross-platform support.
en.hot: With over 30k stars and 84 daily additions, it addresses AI account management pain points with an efficient local relay solution.
uses: Developers managing multiple Antigravity accounts can switch with one click for efficiency.
AI enthusiasts wanting to convert web sessions into APIs for local integration and calls.
Users seeking low-cost, stable AI relay services can leverage sponsor offerings.

zh.tag: Rust 编写的简单数据驱动游戏引擎
zh.what: Bevy 是一个用 Rust 编写的免费开源游戏引擎，采用数据驱动的实体组件系统（ECS）架构，提供完整的 2D 和 3D 功能。它设计简单易用，同时具备高度模块化和并行性能。
zh.content: 仓库包含引擎核心源码、大量可运行示例（examples 目录）、官方文档、迁移指南以及社区资源链接。
zh.stack: 基于 Rust 语言，依赖 Rust 编译器和标准库，使用 Cargo 进行构建和包管理，并集成 wgpu 等图形库。
zh.hot: Bevy 在 GitHub 上已获得 48,735 颗星，本月新增 750 星，位列 Rust 月榜第 17 名，其活跃的社区和持续的开发迭代吸引了大量 Rust 游戏开发者。
uses: Rust 开发者想要尝试游戏开发或构建 2D/3D 游戏原型
技术爱好者学习数据驱动架构和 ECS 设计模式
独立游戏团队寻找开源、可定制的游戏引擎

en.tag: A refreshingly simple data-driven game engine built in Rust
en.what: Bevy is a free and open-source game engine built in Rust, featuring a data-driven Entity Component System (ECS) architecture with full 2D and 3D capabilities. It is designed to be simple for newcomers yet infinitely flexible and fast.
en.content: The repository contains the engine's core source code, numerous runnable examples (in the examples directory), official documentation, migration guides, and links to community resources.
en.stack: Built in Rust, relying on the Rust compiler and standard library, using Cargo for build and package management, and integrating graphics libraries like wgpu.
en.hot: Bevy has garnered 48,735 stars on GitHub, with 750 added this month, ranking 17th on the Rust monthly trending list. Its active community and continuous development attract many Rust game developers.
uses: Rust developers wanting to try game development or build 2D/3D game prototypes
Technology enthusiasts learning data-driven architecture and ECS design patterns
Indie game teams looking for an open-source, customizable game engine

zh.tag: 自托管的云端开发环境与 AI 编码代理平台
zh.what: Coder 是一个可自托管的平台，用 Terraform 定义云端开发环境（工作区），通过安全的 WireGuard 隧道连接，闲置时自动关闭以节省成本。它还内置 AI 编码代理，代理循环运行在你自己的控制平面中，工作区内无需存放任何 API 密钥。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的服务端与 CLI、Terraform 模板与 provider、Web 管理界面、文档和安装脚本，可部署到 EC2、Kubernetes、Docker 等多种基础设施。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 开发，依赖 Terraform 定义基础设施，采用 WireGuard 隧道保障连接安全，并支持接入 Anthropic、OpenAI、Google、Bedrock 或自托管模型。
zh.hot: 凭借 14612 颗星和今日新增 83 星登上 Go 日榜第 16 名，反映出开发者对自托管、安全且带 AI 代理的云端开发环境需求旺盛。
uses: 需要为团队统一管理云端开发环境并控制成本的平台工程团队
希望让 AI 编码代理在自己基础设施上运行、避免密钥外泄的企业
使用 Terraform 管理基础设施、追求可审计与合规的开发组织
想快速为新人开通开发环境、缩短入职时间的工程团队

en.tag: Self-hosted cloud development environments and AI coding agents
en.what: Coder is a self-hosted platform for cloud development environments and AI coding agents. Workspaces are defined with Terraform, connected through a secure WireGuard tunnel, and automatically shut down when idle; its native AI agent runs in your control plane with no API keys inside workspaces.
en.content: The repo contains a Go-based server and CLI, Terraform templates and providers, a web admin UI, docs, and install scripts, deployable across EC2, Kubernetes, Docker, and more.
en.stack: Primarily written in Go, it relies on Terraform for infrastructure definitions, uses WireGuard tunnels for secure connectivity, and supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Bedrock, or self-hosted models.
en.hot: With 14,612 stars and 83 added today, ranking 16th on the Go daily trending list, it reflects strong demand for self-hosted, secure cloud dev environments with AI agents.
uses: Platform engineering teams needing unified, cost-controlled cloud dev environments
Enterprises wanting AI coding agents on their own infra without leaking API keys
Organizations using Terraform that require auditable, compliant infrastructure
Engineering teams aiming to onboard developers in seconds instead of days

zh.tag: 为 AI 编程代理打造的持久记忆系统，单二进制、零依赖
zh.what: Engram 为 AI 编程代理提供跨会话的持久记忆能力，让代理记住项目上下文、决策与偏好，而不是每次从零开始。它通过 MCP 服务器、HTTP API、CLI 和 TUI 统一暴露记忆的写入、同步与召回，且与具体代理无关。
zh.content: 仓库是一个 Go 单体项目，包含 SQLite + FTS5 存储层、MCP 服务器、HTTP API、CLI 与 TUI 多种入口，并配有安装、架构、插件、团队使用等完整文档以及品牌资源。
zh.stack: 主语言 Go，存储基于 SQLite 与 FTS5 全文检索，编译为无外部依赖的单一二进制，可本地运行或接入 Engram Cloud。
zh.hot: AI 代理的记忆缺失是当下最痛的工程问题之一，Engram 以零依赖单二进制和代理无关的设计切中需求，已积累 6844 stars，今日再增 29，登上 Go 日榜第 16。
uses: 重度使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望代理记住项目上下文
需要在团队内共享代理记忆与知识沉淀的工程团队
想自建本地优先、可私有部署的代理记忆基础设施的技术负责人
对 MCP 生态与代理工具链感兴趣、想集成或二次开发的开发者

en.tag: Persistent memory for AI coding agents — one brain, local or cloud
en.what: Engram gives AI coding agents persistent memory across sessions, so they remember project context, decisions and preferences instead of starting from scratch. It exposes remember, sync and recall through an MCP server, HTTP API, CLI and TUI, staying agent-agnostic.
en.content: The repo is a single Go project bundling a SQLite + FTS5 storage layer with MCP server, HTTP API, CLI and TUI entry points, plus full docs on installation, architecture, plugins and team usage alongside branding assets.
en.stack: Written in Go, backed by SQLite with FTS5 full-text search, compiled into a single dependency-free binary that runs locally or connects to Engram Cloud.
en.hot: Memory loss is one of the sharpest pain points in agent engineering today, and Engram's zero-dependency single binary plus agent-agnostic design hits it directly — 6,844 stars with 29 added today, ranking 16th on the Go daily trending list.
uses: Developers heavily using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want them to remember project context
Engineering teams that need to share agent memory and accumulated knowledge across members
Tech leads wanting a local-first, self-hostable memory infrastructure for their agents
Developers interested in the MCP ecosystem who want to integrate or extend the toolchain

zh.tag: 为现有 AI 编程代理提供记忆、工作流与可验证证据的确定性工程环境
zh.what: Gentle-AI 是一个开源配置层，为你已经在用的 AI 编程代理（如 Claude Code、Cursor、OpenCode、Codex、Pi 等 16 种）注入持久记忆、规格驱动开发、精选技能、MCP 服务器、人格设定和可选的有界审查。它不锁定任何代理，目标是让代理写代码后不再失忆，并能证明自己做了什么。
zh.content: 仓库包含 Go 编写的 CLI 工具、文档（快速开始、预期用法、Wiki）、品牌资源以及针对不同代理的配置模板和技能库。
zh.stack: 主要使用 Go 语言开发，跨平台支持 macOS、Linux 和 Windows，采用 MIT 许可证。依赖可能包括各代理的配置接口和 MCP 协议。
zh.hot: 本周新增 411 颗星，总星数达 6911，登上 GitHub Trending 周榜（Go）第 9 名。它解决了 AI 代理缺乏记忆和工作流的痛点，且支持多种主流代理，无锁定，因此受到开发者关注。
uses: 使用 Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 编程代理的开发者，希望增强代理的记忆和工作流能力。
团队需要规格驱动开发和可验证的代理行为，以提升代码质量和可审计性。
希望避免代理锁定，灵活切换或组合多种 AI 编程工具的用户。
对 MCP 服务器、技能库和人格设定等高级功能感兴趣的 AI 工程实践者。

en.tag: A deterministic engineering environment that gives your existing AI coding agents memory, workflow, and evidence.
en.what: Gentle-AI is an open-source configuration layer that injects persistent memory, Spec-Driven Development, curated skills, MCP servers, personas, and optional bounded review into the AI coding agents you already use (16 agents including Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Codex, and Pi). en.content: The repository contains a Go-based CLI tool, documentation (quickstart, intended usage, wiki), brand assets, and configuration templates and skill libraries for different agents.
en.stack: Primarily developed in Go, cross-platform for macOS, Linux, and Windows, under MIT license. Dependencies may include configuration interfaces for various agents and the MCP protocol.
en.hot: It gained 411 stars this week, reaching 6,911 total, and ranked 9th on GitHub Trending weekly (Go). It addresses the pain point of AI agents lacking memory and workflow, supports multiple mainstream agents without lock-in, thus attracting developer attention.
uses: Developers using AI coding agents like Claude Code or Cursor who want to enhance agent memory and workflow.
Teams needing Spec-Driven Development and verifiable agent behavior for better code quality and auditability.

uses: Ops and security teams needing centralized management of DB credentials, API keys and certificates
Platform engineers looking to migrate from Vault to a community-governed, OSI-licensed solution
SREs handling key rotation and auditing in Kubernetes or multi-cloud environments
Compliance staff focused on supply-chain security and OpenSSF best practices

zh.tag: 纯 Go 读写 Excel 电子表格的高性能库
zh.what: Excelize 是一个用纯 Go 编写的库，提供读写 XLAM / XLSM / XLSX / XLTM / XLTX 格式电子表格的函数，兼容 Microsoft Excel 2007 及以后版本生成的文件。它支持复杂组件的高兼容性，并提供流式 API 以处理海量数据的工作表。
zh.content: 仓库包含完整的 Go 库源码、示例代码、文档和测试套件，核心是 excelize 包，提供创建、读取、修改电子表格的 API。
zh.stack: 基于 Go 语言（要求 Go 1.26.0 或更高版本），依赖标准库和少量第三方包，使用 Go Modules 管理依赖。
zh.hot: 凭借纯 Go 实现、高兼容性和流式处理能力，Excelize 成为 Go 生态中处理 Excel 文件的首选库，已获得近 2.1 万星标，本月新增 95 星，位列 GitHub Trending 月榜 Go 语言第 22 名。
uses: Go 后端开发者需要在服务端生成或解析 Excel 报表
数据分析师用 Go 处理大规模 Excel 数据导入导出
企业应用集成 Excel 文件读写功能，如财务、ERP 系统
开源项目需要轻量级、无 CGO 依赖的电子表格处理方案

en.tag: Pure Go library for reading and writing Excel spreadsheets
en.what: Excelize is a pure Go library providing functions to read and write XLAM / XLSM / XLSX / XLTM / XLTX spreadsheets, compatible with files generated by Microsoft Excel 2007 and later. It supports complex components with high compatibility and offers a streaming API for handling worksheets with huge amounts of data.
en.content: The repository contains the full Go library source, examples, documentation, and test suite, with the core excelize package offering APIs to create, read, and modify spreadsheets.
en.stack: Built in Go (requires Go 1.26.0 or later), depending on the standard library and a few third-party packages, with Go Modules for dependency management.
en.hot: With its pure Go implementation, high compatibility, and streaming capabilities, Excelize has become the go-to library for handling Excel files in the Go ecosystem, earning nearly 21k stars, with 95 added this month, ranking 22nd on GitHub Trending monthly for Go.
uses: Go backend developers needing to generate or parse Excel reports server-side
Data analysts processing large-scale Excel data import/export in Go
Enterprise applications integrating Excel file read/write, such as finance and ERP systems
Open-source projects requiring a lightweight, CGO-free spreadsheet processing solution

zh.tag: 2美元ESP32-C3上的Pi-hole级DNS广告拦截器，无需PSRAM
zh.what: 这是一个运行在廉价ESP32-C3开发板上的DNS广告拦截器，功能类似Pi-hole。它把53.7万个域名以40位FNV-1a哈希的形式存入闪存，通过二分查找实现拦截，无需PSRAM，仅占用约50KB内存即可在约10毫秒内响应被拦截的查询。
zh.content: 仓库包含C++固件源码、PlatformIO构建配置、Web仪表盘，以及一个可3D打印的C3 SuperMini外壳STL文件。
zh.stack: 基于C++与PlatformIO开发，面向ESP32-C3（也支持经典ESP32），使用UDP DNS sinkhole与闪存哈希表，依赖WiFi联网。
zh.hot: 上线即登上GitHub Trending日榜C++第2名，今日新增476星、总星2258。它被Tom's Hardware、XDA等媒体报道，用极低成本实现Pi-hole级拦截，极具话题性。
uses: 想低成本搭建家庭网络广告拦截的DIY爱好者
拥有ESP32-C3开发板、想折腾嵌入式网络项目的开发者
关注闪存哈希、内存优化等嵌入式技巧的工程师
希望用USB小棒即插即用拦截广告的普通用户

en.tag: A Pi-hole-class DNS ad-blocker on a $2 ESP32-C3, no PSRAM required
en.what: This is a DNS ad-blocker running on a cheap ESP32-C3 board, functionally similar to Pi-hole. It stores 537k domains as 40-bit FNV-1a hashes in flash and binary-searches them, requiring no PSRAM and using only ~50KB of RAM to answer blocked lookups in about 10ms.
en.content: The repo contains C++ firmware source, PlatformIO build configs, a web dashboard, and a printable STL enclosure for the C3 SuperMini.
en.stack: Built in C++ with PlatformIO for the ESP32-C3 (classic ESP32 also supported), using a UDP DNS sinkhole and a flash hash table, relying on WiFi connectivity.
en.hot: It hit #2 on GitHub Trending (C++) with 476 stars today and 2,258 total. Featured by Tom's Hardware and XDA, it's a buzzworthy feat of Pi-hole-class blocking at extremely low cost.
uses: DIY enthusiasts wanting low-cost home network ad blocking
Developers with an ESP32-C3 board looking for an embedded networking project
Engineers interested in flash hashing and memory optimization tricks
Everyday users wanting a plug-and-play USB dongle to block ads

zh.tag: 纯C/C++的高性能LLM推理引擎
zh.what: llama.cpp 是一个用纯 C/C++ 编写的高性能大语言模型推理引擎，支持在 CPU 和 GPU 上高效运行。它针对本地部署和资源受限环境进行了优化，无需依赖庞大的深度学习框架。
zh.content: 仓库包含核心推理库 libllama、命令行工具、REST API 服务器（llama-server）以及 WebUI。支持多种量化格式（如 GGUF）和模型架构（如 LLaMA、GPT-OSS）。
zh.stack: 纯 C/C++ 实现，依赖 ggml 张量库，可选支持 CUDA、Vulkan、Metal 等 GPU 加速后端。
zh.hot: 作为最流行的本地 LLM 推理方案之一，llama.cpp 持续获得社区关注，今日新增 159 星，总星数突破 12 万。其高性能、跨平台和易用性使其成为 AI 开发者和爱好者的首选。
uses: AI 开发者：在本地或边缘设备上运行和测试大语言模型
隐私敏感用户：无需联网即可使用 LLM，数据完全本地化
研究人员：探索模型量化、推理优化和自定义模型架构

en.tag: High-performance LLM inference engine in pure C/C++
en.what: llama.cpp is a high-performance LLM inference engine written in pure C/C++, optimized for CPU and GPU execution. It enables efficient local deployment without heavy deep learning frameworks.
en.content: The repo includes the core inference library libllama, CLI tools, a REST API server (llama-server), and a WebUI. It supports various quantization formats (e.g., GGUF) and model architectures (e.g., LLaMA, GPT-OSS).
en.stack: Pure C/C++ implementation, relies on the ggml tensor library, with optional GPU backends like CUDA, Vulkan, and Metal.
en.hot: As one of the most popular local LLM inference solutions, llama.cpp continues to gain community traction with 159 new stars today, surpassing 120K total. Its performance, cross-platform support, and ease of use make it a top choice for AI developers and enthusiasts.
uses: AI developers: run and test LLMs locally or on edge devices
Privacy-conscious users: use LLMs offline with full data locality
Researchers: explore quantization, inference optimization, and custom model architectures

zh.tag: 苹果平台 Firebase 官方开源 SDK，覆盖认证、数据库、推送与 AI 能力
zh.what: 这是 Firebase 面向 Apple 平台（iOS/macOS/tvOS/watchOS）的官方开源 SDK 源码仓库，除 FirebaseAnalytics 外几乎所有 Firebase 产品库都在这里。它为开发者提供认证、云数据库、推送、崩溃分析、性能监控等后端服务的客户端接入能力。
zh.content: 仓库按产品拆分为多个子模块，如 FirebaseAI、FirebaseAuth、FirebaseFirestore、FirebaseMessaging、FirebaseCrashlytics 等，并配有 Package.swift、Podspec 及示例与测试代码。
zh.stack: 以 C++ 与 Objective-C/Swift 混合实现，支持 Swift Package Manager 与 CocoaPods 两种集成方式，依赖 Apple 各平台原生框架。
